title: Senior Finance Manager (E-commerce))
description:
Tee Ess

**We Are Hiring**

**Designation:**

**Finance Manager – E-commerce**

**Experience:**

**8 to 10 years**

**Educational Qualification:**

**• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline from a recognized university.**

**• CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) / M.Com or other relevant postgraduate qualification will be preferred.**

**• Professional certifications in financial management, taxation, accounting, data analytics, or ERP systems will be an added advantage.**

**Experience:**

**• Minimum 6–10 years of experience in Finance, Accounting, Commercial Finance, Business Finance, or E-commerce Finance.**

**• Strong hands-on experience in E-commerce finance, marketplace finance, D2C finance, or digital commerce operations is preferred.**

**• Candidates with experience in Color Cosmetics, Beauty, Personal Care, FMCG, Consumer Goods, D2C, Retail, or E-commerce businesses will be preferred.**

**• Proven experience in revenue reconciliation, marketplace settlements, payment gateway reconciliation, working capital, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.**

**• Experience in managing Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Shopify, D2C platforms, payment gateways, and other E-commerce channels will be an added advantage.**

**• Experience in financial analysis, margin management, cost control, inventory accounting, and business performance analysis.**

**Role Summary:**

**The Finance Manager – E-commerce will be responsible for managing and overseeing Tee Ess' finance and accounting operations across its E-commerce, D2C, marketplace, and digital sales channels. The role will focus on revenue reconciliation, marketplace settlements, profitability analysis, working capital management, budgeting, forecasting, inventory accounting, cost optimization, and financial reporting.**

**The position will work closely with E-commerce, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and Leadership teams to provide accurate financial insights, improve channel profitability, strengthen financial controls, and support sustainable business growth.**

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**E-commerce Finance & Revenue Management**

**• Manage end-to-end finance operations for Tee Ess' E-commerce, D2C, marketplace, and digital sales channels.**

**• Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales revenue across marketplaces and E-commerce platforms.**

**• Reconcile orders, sales, cancellations, returns, refunds, discounts, commissions, shipping charges, and other marketplace deductions.**

**• Ensure accurate accounting of revenue across Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra, Shopify, D2C platforms, and other sales channels.**

**• Track marketplace settlements and ensure timely reconciliation of receivables.**

**• Identify and resolve discrepancies between E-commerce platforms, payment gateways, ERP systems, and accounting records.**

**• Monitor channel-wise revenue, contribution margins, profitability, and financial performance.**

**Marketplace & Payment Reconciliation**

**• Perform regular reconciliation of marketplace statements, payment gateway settlements, bank collections, and ERP/accounting records.**

**• Monitor marketplace commissions, advertising charges, logistics costs, penalties, returns, refunds, and other deductions.**

**• Identify revenue leakage, incorrect deductions, short settlements, and unreconciled transactions.**

**• Coordinate with E-commerce and marketplace teams to resolve settlement and payment discrepancies.**

**• Maintain accurate reconciliation statements and ensure closure of outstanding items within defined timelines.**

**Financial Planning & Analysis**

**• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets for E-commerce and D2C operations.**

**• Develop financial forecasts based on sales trends, product performance, marketing plans, inventory levels, and business projections.**

**• Prepare channel-wise and product-wise profitability analysis.**

**• Analyze gross margin, contribution margin, EBITDA, CAC, ROAS, AOV, return rates, and other relevant E-commerce financial metrics.**

**• Provide financial insights to management for pricing, promotions, product launches, marketing investments, and business expansion decisions.**

**• Conduct variance analysis between actual performance and budget/forecast and recommend corrective actions.**

**Cost & Profitability Management**

**• Monitor and control E-commerce operating costs, marketplace commissions, logistics expenses, payment gateway charges, promotional discounts, and marketing spends.**

**• Evaluate the financial impact of discounts, coupons, promotional campaigns, and marketplace offers.**

**• Analyze product-level and channel-level contribution margins to identify profitable and underperforming categories.**

**• Work with Marketing and E-commerce teams to evaluate campaign profitability and ROI.**

**• Identify opportunities for cost optimization and revenue improvement across E-commerce operations.**

**Inventory & Working Capital Management**

**• Monitor inventory valuation, stock movement, ageing, provisions, and inventory-related financial impact.**

**• Coordinate with Supply Chain and Operations teams to optimize inventory levels and working capital.**

**• Monitor slow-moving, non-moving, damaged, expired, and obsolete inventory and recommend appropriate financial provisions/actions.**

**• Track accounts receivable, accounts payable, payment cycles, and working capital requirements.**

**• Prepare working capital analysis and recommend initiatives to improve cash flow.**

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

**• Ensure accurate recording and accounting of E-commerce transactions in the ERP/accounting system.**

**• Prepare monthly MIS, management reports, profitability statements, and financial dashboards.**

**• Support month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, provisions, reconciliations, and revenue recognition.**

**• Ensure accurate accounting of sales returns, refunds, discounts, commissions, freight, marketplace charges, and other E-commerce-related expenses.**

**• Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and internal stakeholders for financial and statutory requirements.**

**• Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, GST, TDS, and other relevant statutory requirements.**

**Business Finance & Commercial Support**

**• Partner with E-commerce, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations teams to support business decisions.**

**• Evaluate new marketplace/channel opportunities from a financial and commercial perspective.**

**• Support pricing decisions by analyzing product costs, marketplace charges, logistics costs, discounts, and desired margins.**

**• Review commercial terms with marketplaces, vendors, logistics partners, agencies, and other business partners.**

**• Support management in evaluating business cases, investments, new product launches, and expansion initiatives.**

**MIS, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

**• Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly finance dashboards for E-commerce business performance.**

**• Develop automated reports and dashboards for revenue, profitability, reconciliation, collections, expenses, and working capital.**

**• Analyze financial data to identify trends, risks, revenue leakages, and opportunities for improvement.**

**• Implement stronger financial controls and reconciliation processes across E-commerce operations.**

**• Drive process improvements through ERP, automation, analytics, and technology-enabled finance solutions.**

**Team & Cross-functional Coordination**

**• Lead and manage finance activities related to Tee Ess' E-commerce business.**

**• Coordinate with internal finance and accounting teams to ensure timely closure of transactions and reconciliations.**

**• Collaborate closely with E-commerce, Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, Warehouse, and Operations teams.**

**• Establish clear financial processes, controls, and accountability across E-commerce operations.**

**• Support and mentor team members in E-commerce finance, reconciliation, reporting, and analysis.**

**Required Skills & Expertise:**

**• Strong knowledge of E-commerce finance, marketplace settlements, revenue reconciliation, and D2C business models.**

**• Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.**

**• Hands-on experience with Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra, Shopify, D2C platforms, payment gateways, or similar E-commerce ecosystems will be preferred.**

**• Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, taxation, accounting principles, and financial controls.**

**• Proficiency in ERP/accounting systems such as SAP, Oracle, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar platforms.**

**• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, dashboards, and financial modelling.**

**• Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence/reporting tools will be an added advantage.**

**• Strong analytical, numerical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.**

**• Strong commercial understanding and business acumen.**

**• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.**

**Preferred Industry Experience:**

**Candidates with experience in the following industries will be preferred:**

**• Color Cosmetics / Beauty & Cosmetics**

**• D2C / E-commerce**

**• FMCG / Consumer Goods**

**• Personal Care / Beauty Products**

**• Retail**

**• Consumer Brands**

**• Marketplace-driven businesses**

**Candidates with direct experience in Color Cosmetics and E-commerce Finance will be strongly preferred.**

**Personal Attributes:**

**• Commercially oriented and financially astute professional.**

**• Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail.**

**• Result-driven with a strong focus on accuracy and financial discipline.**

**• Proactive, process-oriented, and solution-focused.**

**• Strong ownership and accountability.**

**• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced E-commerce environment.**

**• Collaborative leader with strong interpersonal and stakeholder management abilities.**

**• Adaptable and comfortable working with changing business priorities and high-growth environments.**

**Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

**• E-commerce Revenue Reconciliation Accuracy.**

**• Marketplace Settlement Reconciliation TAT.**

**• Revenue Leakage / Recovery.**

**• E-commerce Gross Margin & Contribution Margin.**

**• Channel-wise Profitability.**

**• Budget vs. Actual Variance.**

**• Working Capital Improvement.**

**• Accounts Receivable / Collection Efficiency.**

**• Inventory Accuracy & Inventory Value Optimization.**

**• Cost Reduction / Cost Optimization.**

**• Marketplace Commission & Expense Optimization.**

**• Financial Reporting Accuracy & Timeliness.**

**• Month-end Closing TAT.**

**• MIS Reporting Accuracy and Timeliness.**

**• Compliance and Audit Closure.**

**Working Conditions:**

**• Full-time position based at Tee Ess' corporate office.**

**• Regular coordination with Finance, E-commerce, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Warehouse, Operations, marketplaces, payment gateways, and external business partners.**

**• Extended working hours may be required during month-end/year-end closing, major sales campaigns, festive periods, product launches, and business-critical operations.**

**• Occasional travel may be required to Tee Ess' offices, warehouses, manufacturing facilities, marketplaces, vendors, and business partner locations as required.**

**Salary Range – Upto 1 lakh per month**

title: Pricing Analyst - Senior
description:
**Job Summary**
The Pricing Analyst – Senior is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing pricing strategies that drive profitable growth while maintaining market competitiveness. This role leads pricing operations, pricing analytics, and cross-functional pricing initiatives by ensuring accurate pricing data, executing strategic price revisions, supporting customer pricing, and delivering actionable business insights. The position collaborates closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, and business leadership to align pricing decisions with organizational objectives, enhance pricing processes, and improve customer value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development, implementation, and execution of pricing strategies that support business growth, profitability, and competitive positioning.
* Plan, analyze, obtain approvals for, and execute annual and mid-year pricing revisions across multiple product lines and market segments.
* Maintain accurate pricing data across ERP, CRM, order management, rebate, and pricing systems, ensuring data integrity and first-time accuracy.
* Manage multiple pricing structures and price lists while ensuring synchronization across enterprise systems.
* Prepare customer quotations and pricing proposals in collaboration with Sales teams and support complex customer pricing negotiations.
* Analyze pricing performance, market trends, customer behavior, competitive intelligence, and win/loss data to recommend pricing improvements and business actions.
* Lead pricing governance forums and facilitate collaborative pricing decisions with Sales, Finance, and business leadership.
* Design and continuously improve pricing methodologies, pricing policies, and pricing philosophies aligned with business objectives.
* Lead pricing analytics initiatives by leveraging business intelligence, automation, AI, and digital tools to improve pricing effectiveness and decision-making.
* Develop reports, dashboards, forecasts, and executive presentations that provide meaningful pricing insights and business recommendations.
* Lead pricing improvement projects, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure timely resolution of complex pricing issues while providing excellent support to internal and external customers.
* Maintain confidentiality of pricing information and ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Monitor pricing operational KPIs including turnaround time, accuracy, and service levels, implementing corrective actions where required.
* Coach, mentor, and develop pricing team members while fostering a collaborative, high-performance work environment.

Build strong partnerships across Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, Supply Chain, and other business functions to achieve shared business goals.
  
  
**Core Competencies**

* Pricing Strategy & Execution
* Pricing Analytics & Business Intelligence
* Market Analysis & Forecasting
* Financial & Commercial Acumen
* Customer Pricing & Quotation Management
* Data Analysis & Decision Making
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Stakeholder Management & Influencing
* Project Leadership & Continuous Improvement
* ERP, CRM & Pricing Systems Management
* AI & Digital Analytics Adoption
* Problem Solving & Critical Thinking
* Process Excellence
* Customer Focus
* Effective Communication
* Accountability & Ownership
* Managing Ambiguity
* Building Networks
* Collaboration
* Coaching & Team Development
* Valuing Diverse Perspectives

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Marketing, Strategy, Accounting, Business Administration , or a related discipline is required.
* Master's degree or relevant professional certifications in Pricing, Finance, Analytics, or Business Management are preferred.
* Position may require compliance with applicable export controls or sanctions regulations.

**Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in pricing, commercial finance, pricing analytics, sales operations, business analytics, or related commercial functions.
* Experience developing and implementing pricing strategies within manufacturing, automotive, industrial, aftermarket, or B2B environments is preferred.
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience interpreting large datasets and translating insights into business recommendations.
* Experience managing complex pricing structures, customer pricing, rebates, quotations, and enterprise pricing systems.
* Working knowledge of ERP and CRM platforms (such as Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or equivalent).
* Experience leading pricing governance, cross-functional projects, and strategic pricing initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate across multiple business functions.
* Experience leading or mentoring teams and driving employee development.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting/analytics tools; experience with Power BI, Tableau, AI-enabled analytics, or similar platforms is advantageous.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high levels of accuracy, quality, and customer focus.
* The position is for India aftermarket DBU Pricing leader.
* Lead a team of three office employees – who manage the day to day DBU pricing operations and Pricing analytics.
* Takes care of the strategic pricing – which involves carrying out all the mass scale annual and mid year price revisions – including planning, analysis, seeking approvals from pricing councils, execution of the actions, providing the right justifications to the market etc.
* Leads the DBU Pricing councils. Ensures decisions are taken collaboratively by the Pricing, Finance and Sales leaders in this forum.
* Manage DBU out pricing along with the team for multiple Oracle price lists. Ensure sync with the CRM systems.
* Manage the DBU Direct customer pricing. Prepare the quotations to these customers in co-ordination with the sales team expectations and sometimes participate in the customer pricing negotiations.
* Lead business projects to align pricing with market expectations. Support the team to clear price challenges on regular basis.
* Lead Pricing analytics projects and implement AI analytics and tools in collaboration with the IT team
* Provide daily guidance to the team for day to day clearances. Ensure right pricing methodologies are followed and accurate pricing set ups are done at the first time.
* Maintain the team KPIs of Turn around time and accuracy.
* Design the pricing philosophies for this business in co-ordination with the sales leaders
* The role involves massive cross functional and leadership collaboration.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
Company: Blessing Softtech Pvt. Ltd.

Product: Fonazo – AI-Powered Voice Agent & Subscription Platform

Job Title: FinOps Engineer

Experience: 4+ Years

Qualification: Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, or a related field

Location: Pune

Work Mode: Work from Office

Joining: Immediate joiners preferred

Salary: As per experience and industry standards

Job Summary

Blessing Softtech Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced FinOps Engineer with a strong background in Finance, FinTech, subscription billing, and payment gateway management to run financial operations for clients using Fonazo, our AI-powered voice agent and subscription platform.

The ideal candidate has 4+ years of hands-on experience with subscription billing, payment processing, reconciliation, settlements, refunds, chargebacks, and gateway integrations, and knows providers such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay (FIS Global), 2Checkout (Verifone), Square, Payoneer, and Amazon Pay.

The role covers end-to-end financial operations for multiple clients with full financial transparency across the Fonazo platform.

Key Responsibilities

1. Subscription Billing & Revenue Management

• Manage end-to-end billing for Fonazo clients: recurring payments, plans, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations.

• Monitor revenue, billing cycles, failed payments, pending invoices, and receivables; track MRR, ARR, CLV, churn, and subscription growth.

• Ensure accurate calculation of charges, prorated billing, discounts, promotions, taxes, and fees; identify billing discrepancies and revenue leakage, find root causes, and implement fixes.

• Work with product and development teams to automate billing workflows.

2. Payment Gateway Management & Integration

• Manage operations across the gateways listed above and other providers: settings, transaction workflows, settlement schedules, payment methods, and recurring billing.

• Track payment success rates, declines, gateway fees, transaction costs, refunds, and settlement discrepancies across providers.

• Work with technical teams to troubleshoot integration issues, API billing errors, webhook failures, and transaction status mismatches.

• Evaluate gateway performance, pricing, currencies, coverage, and settlement timelines to recommend solutions for clients.

• Reconcile gateway records with Fonazo subscription records, invoices, and bank settlements.

3. Financial Reconciliation & Settlement Management

• Perform daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation of gateway transactions, invoices, customer payments, refunds, and bank settlements, verifying gross values, fees, commissions, taxes, net settlements, and pending or disputed transactions.

• Investigate and resolve discrepancies across gateways, billing systems, accounting records, and bank statements; monitor settlement delays, failed payouts, duplicate transactions, reversals, and unaccounted entries.

• Maintain accurate ledgers, transaction registers, settlement reports, and audit documentation; coordinate with Accounts and Finance on recording revenue, receivables, gateway charges, and settlements.

4. Client Financial Operations & Account Management

• Manage subscription finance for multiple Fonazo clients: billing, collection, revenue reporting, and account-level records, including each client's plans, active subscriptions, transaction history, invoices, balances, refunds, and payment status.

• Prepare client-wise statements covering revenue, collections, failed payments, refunds, gateway charges, and net settlements.

• Resolve client billing disputes, payment failures, invoice discrepancies, refund requests, and settlement queries; communicate promptly on failed payments, pending dues, and billing changes.

• Maintain clear records of client transactions, payment histories, and subscription changes.

5. Refunds, Chargebacks & Dispute Management

• Manage refunds, chargebacks, reversals, and disputed transactions per company policy and gateway requirements; investigate disputes, gather evidence, and coordinate with providers for timely resolution.

• Monitor chargeback ratios, refund trends, and fraud indicators.

• Define procedures for refund approvals, verification, dispute escalation, and adjustments.

• Work with support and technical teams to identify dispute causes and prevent recurrence; document all refunds, chargebacks, disputes, and outcomes.

6. Financial Reporting, MIS & Analytics

• Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports on revenue, collections, transaction volumes, failed payments, refunds, and settlements; build dashboards tracking MRR, ARR, churn, renewals, payment success, receivables, and leakage.

• Analyze gateway fees, subscription performance, client profitability, transaction costs, and revenue trends; prepare client-wise and gateway-wise reports for management and business reviews.

• Identify irregularities, recurring billing issues, and inefficiencies through data analysis, using Excel, SQL, Power BI, or similar tools to automate reporting.

7. Financial Controls, Compliance & Risk Management

• Establish internal controls for billing, refunds, settlements, revenue recognition, and adjustments.

• Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax rules, provider policies, regulatory obligations, and data protection and payment requirements across relevant markets.

• Maintain audit trails, approval workflows, and supporting documents for audits.

• Coordinate with finance, compliance, and technical teams on PCI DSS and secure payment handling; monitor suspicious transactions, duplicate charges, unauthorized refunds, and fraud indicators.

8. Product & Technical Team Coordination

• Work with product, backend, QA, and DevOps teams to improve Fonazo's billing and payment modules.

• Translate financial requirements into functional specs for plans, billing logic, invoices, retries, refunds, and settlement workflows.

• Validate gateway integrations, lifecycle events, billing calculations, and reconciliation during releases; coordinate testing of payment APIs, webhooks, recurring billing, failed-payment recovery, and refund workflows.

• Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual reconciliation and streamline onboarding; help build scalable workflows for growing volumes and multiple client accounts.

9. Subscription Performance & Payment Optimization

• Analyze failed and declined transactions to identify causes and recommend corrective actions.

• Run dunning, automated retries, renewal reminders, and failed-payment recovery.

• Evaluate gateway performance to improve approval rates and reduce processing costs; monitor cancellations, involuntary churn, payment-related drop-offs, and recurring billing issues.

• Recommend improvements to pricing, billing frequency, payment methods, and collection workflows; partner with product and customer success teams to improve renewals, payment experience, and revenue retention.

10. Accounting, Budgeting & Financial Planning

• Support revenue forecasting, cash flow planning, budgeting, and management reports for Fonazo operations.

• Maintain accurate records of receivables, deferred revenue where applicable, gateway fees, refunds, and related entries.

• Coordinate with accounting on monthly closing, reconciliation, financial statements, and audits.

• Analyze client-wise revenue, operating costs, processing charges, and contribution margins; recommend improvements to strengthen controls, reduce costs, and improve cash flow visibility.

Required Technical & Functional Skills

• Strong understanding of subscription billing, recurring payments, payment processing, revenue reconciliation, and financial operations; hands-on experience with one or more of the gateways listed above.

• Knowledge of subscription lifecycle management, invoicing, retries, refunds, chargebacks, and settlement reconciliation.

• Understanding of financial reporting, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, gateway fees, and cash flow management.

• Proficiency in Excel (PivotTables, lookups, financial reporting) and MIS dashboards/Power BI or Tableau; working knowledge of SQL preferred.

• Advantageous: understanding of gateway APIs, webhooks, and reconciliation workflows; familiarity with accounting/ERP and automated billing platforms; knowledge of international payments, multi-currency, cross-border settlements, and applicable tax treatment.

Educational Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, Business Administration, or related discipline (required); Master's in Finance, FinTech, Accounting, or Business Administration (preferred).

• Certifications in FinTech, payment systems, financial analysis, accounting, or financial operations are an added advantage.

Experience Requirements

• Minimum 4+ years in FinOps, subscription finance, payment operations, billing and reconciliation, or FinTech financial operations, with proven hands-on gateway and recurring-payment experience.

• Experience managing financial operations for multiple clients or subscription products, handling reconciliation, failed payments, refunds, chargebacks, settlement reports, and revenue tracking.

• Experience with SaaS, AI, voice-agent, or other recurring-revenue models is highly desirable, as is collaboration with finance, product, engineering, and support teams on complex payment issues.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Accuracy and timeliness of billing, reconciliation, client-wise revenue records, and MIS reports/dashboards.

• Reduction in unresolved settlement discrepancies, unaccounted transactions, gateway costs, and preventable revenue leakage.

• Payment success rate and failed-payment recovery; timeliness of collections, refunds, and dispute resolution.

• Effectiveness of billing automation and process improvements; compliance with internal controls and audit requirements.

* • Quality of coordination with clients, finance, and technical teams.

title: Business Intelligence Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Your role as a Business Intelligence Senior Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
* Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
* Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
* Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
* Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
* Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
* Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates
* Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
* Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.
* Monthly (Long Term Monitoring): Lead the monthly review process with Marketplace, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to track the key drivers of our spend on an ongoing basis.
* Be intimately involved in the quarterly and annual planning process and be aware of what assumptions went into the plan.
* Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting
* Provide regular updates on Steering Committees. Revenue Monitoring Process Improvement.
* Reduce “blind spots” by developing new monitoring frameworks and incorporating new data sources into existing monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and external vendors to improve existing anomaly detection solutions, based on KPI performance.
* Rollout and Recovery Tracking: Work closely with the monetization product team to track and quantify the impact of product releases.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* Proven 5 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, or a similar role, is preferred.
* Communication Skills - Ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Technical skills such as Excel, Looker, MYSQL, forecasting, impact measurement, AB Testing, are a must.
* Knowledge of Excel macro/VBA, Python, and Ad Tech experience is good to have.
* Experience with GenAI-based tools like Cursor and Claude will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of data manipulation and analysis.
* Familiarity with anomaly detection techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning methods, time-series analysis, and outlier detection algorithms.
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.
* Problem Solving - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work with ambiguous data.
* Attention to Detail - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all work.
* Shift Timings - 3.00 PM to 12 midnight
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.

**Qualification**

* Should have a Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, and broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

**Assistant Director – Corporate Finance**
As part of our EY-Corporate finance practice, you will help clients understand the value of their business, securities, intellectual property, capital equipment, intangibles and other assets. The group is comprised of several key areas, including business valuation, business modelling, capital equipment and complex securities.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Assistant Director with expertise in Corporate Finance Consulting to join EY-VME (Valuation, Modelling and Economics). Our corporate finance consultants help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we support our clients with their capital allocation decisions.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm and develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring, and learning & development. Specifically, you will be a part of the team that helps the clients understand the valuation implications of their corporate finance, capital allocation, restructuring and / or transaction related decisions.
  
  
**GDS Valuation, Modeling and Economics (VME)**
Within SaT, our VME professionals balance strong technical expertise with extensive sector and account focus to deliver integrated, multi-skill solutions and advanced decision support to our clients. We seek to leverage our deep financial, economics and analytics skills to help our clients in managing their risk/return trade-offs thereby supporting with better decision making around financing and capital efficiency.
  
  
VME comprises the full suite of valuation-related services, including Business Valuation, Business Modelling, Capital Equipment, Quantitative Finance & Economics, Corporate Finance, and Real Estate Valuation services. Our corporate finance team guides our clients’ on issues ranging from capital allocation, exploring strategic alternatives, portfolio review and optimization, financial planning to M&A advisory services. We provide them with valuable insights through use of valuation, modelling, and data analytics techniques.
  
  
With over 3,500 valuation professionals worldwide (600+ in GDS VME), no similarly positioned global professional organization can match our breadth of capabilities or our depth of resources.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Understand key client problems and taking a lead role in conducting analyses related to solving their problems in the corporate finance arena and reporting results
* Assume a steering role in report generation and detailed financial modelling
* Develop deep understanding of the markets and key clients to identify opportunities for new services and solutions, that drive sustainable growth and future-proof our business; lead conversations with stakeholders with consulting and problem-solving mindset
* Take ownership of your projects, while working collaboratively with other team members
* Maintain and develop positive, productive, and professional relationships with clients and winning repeat business
* Deep functional and sector knowledge is required to ensure value-driven and insightful results
* Lead high-complexity engagements and critical account relationships to build a successful partnership and become a trusted advisor to clients and EY onsite leaders
* Measure and monitor key performance metrics and make required interventions to bring performance on course
* Supervise, develop and mentor professionals at the Staff and Senior level

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Deep understanding of the financial valuation methods including DCF and relative valuations
* Use current technology and tools to enhance the effectiveness of services provided
* Experience in Equity Research, Investment Banking and Corporate Finance
* Excellent analytical, project-management, communication, interpersonal, and teaming skills
* The ability to work within a given budget and schedule, providing top-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Willingness and ability to travel, when necessary.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A post graduate degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting (CA) or business.
* A minimum of 10+ years of relevant experience with a national valuation firm or accounting firm’s valuation practice, or in quantitative management or litigation consulting, investment banking, private equity/venture capital or commercial banking
* Achievement of or significant progress towards a CFA, CPA, FRM, PRM or PMP designation is a plus, with an expectation of the completion of one designation within a given timeframe.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project and people management skills
* Strong communication, presentation and relationship building skills
* The successful candidate must be committed to staying at the cutting edge of both, latest derivative valuation techniques and the financial and accounting standards that guide the use of these techniques.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 3500 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Record to Report (RTR) Accounting & Opex Specialist - VOIS
description:

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced finance professional to join the ARC RTR Northern Hub team in Pune. This role is responsible for managing end-to-end operational expenditure (Opex) accounting and reporting processes, ensuring compliance with Vodafone accounting policies, IFRS standards, SOX requirements, and agreed service levels. The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders to deliver accurate month-end reporting, drive process improvements, support automation initiatives, and maintain strong financial controls.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Manage, review, analyse and report monthly Opex performance for key stakeholders within agreed reporting deadlines.Own the end-to-end Opex process for the assigned business area.Perform accounting and reporting activities in line with stakeholder requirements, Vodafone accounting policies, and IFRS standards.Deliver agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).Ensure 100% compliance with SOX controls and maintain a zero-tolerance approach towards control failures.Support month-end, half-year-end and year-end close activities.Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations.Collaborate with stakeholders to address reporting and accounting requirements.Drive process simplification, continuous improvement and automation opportunities.Share knowledge and support colleagues in achieving team objectives.Build broader business understanding and contribute to additional responsibilities as required.
  
  
**Who You Are**
Professionally qualified as a Chartered Accountant (CA), Cost and Management Accountant (CMA), CA Inter, or a working professional with relevant domain knowledge and experience.Strong accounting and financial reporting knowledge.Good understanding of Record to Report (RTR) processes.Experience working with ERP systems such as Oracle and SAP.Knowledge of IFRS and corporate accounting policies.Understanding of SOX controls and compliance requirements.Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.Analytical, organised and detail-oriented approach to work.Ability to take ownership and contribute to process improvement initiatives.Collaborative team player with a focus on delivering quality outcomes.
  
  
**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

title: Global Investment Product Analyst
description:
**About The Global Investment Product Analyst Program**
The Global Product Analyst program is seeking a junior to mid-level analyst with some work experience to work in Pune as part of our global teams. Each analyst will own two remits (a “major” and “minor”) across a two to four-year period. Balancing multiple responsibilities requires the analyst to master a broad skill set, have a wide understanding of business development in asset management, and complete projects that are critical to the success of the group, department or firm. On a biannual basis, the analyst will present learnings and contributions to the broader Global Business Development organization. Analysts will meet with their major and minor stakeholders regularly to collaborate on their responsibilities and will have the opportunity to become embedded in the teams they are supporting. After successfully completing two years in the program, the firm has the option based on performance and personnel needs to place the analyst in a full-time position on the team they are supporting or in other areas in which the analyst expresses interest and where there is skills alignment. Throughout the program, the program sponsors invest in the analysts’ growth through intensive training, development opportunities, and mentorship. A non-exhaustive list of potential major and minor remits include: the various asset class business development teams, Request for Proposal, Client Response Center, Product Strategy and Development, and vehicle teams (ETF, SMA, etc).
  
  
**Specific Responsibilities May Include But Are Not Limited To**

* Prepare and maintain marketing presentation materials: gather market data, portfolio characteristics, performance data, etc. to support product messaging across investment products
* Respond to ad hoc inquiries and requests for investment product views, portfolio attributes, and current positioning across products, as well as our firm’s asset class views and outlooks
* Analyze and report on the competitive positioning of our investment products as well as industry trends; help support our product development and commercial efforts
* Contribute to monthly portfolio performance commentaries and market outlooks. This involves an understanding of market events and investment products
* Attend relevant investment strategy meetings to stay current on investment strategies
* Actively seek ways to leverage technology for process improvements, presentation standardization, and automation

The ideal candidate should have:
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree
* 1-5 years of experience in the financial services industry
* Knowledge of and intellectually curious about finance and investing
* Must be very comfortable pulling and analyzing data from multiple systems and using data to drive sales and product positioning ideas
* Comfort working with many technology platforms, including a deep familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with systems such as Morningstar Direct and Bloomberg a plus
* A team player with highly developed interpersonal skills, including collaboration, negotiation and consensus building. Highly motivated self-starter
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, adhering to tight deadlines and maintaining strategic relationships with internal partners and a demonstrated track record of collaboration across time zones with bias to proactively updating stakeholders
* Excellent communication skills, Strong writing skills, highly detail-oriented and organized
* Series 7 FINRA certification or willingness to obtain
* Current CFA or progressing towards preferred
* Creativity and a marketing “sense” is a distinct plus

title: Deputy Project Controller
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  

* Familiarization with the process of project control procedures
* Understanding Contract vis-à-vis project scope of work
* Developing Cost WBS structure and control budget for the project based on the approved estimate.
* Proactively monitor and communicate budget, actual status, and forecast costs/labor hours for projects monthly.
* Consolidate performance data to support performance measurement, data analysis, and cost forecasting.
* Assist in the development of project work plans and schedules.
* Create client and internal status reports that effectively communicate schedule status and identify critical path.
* Provide technical guidance to other project controls staff in project financial status
* Ensuring all financials are in order, preparing spreadsheets and a wide variety of routine cost analyses, cash flow, and other cost related evaluations.
* Set-up, monitor & report earned value progress measurement systems for projects, including analysis based on input from project leads
* Identify business acumen by identifying for us potential project problems early, report issues and problems to operations leadership, and work with project teams to address and implement recovery plans.
* Review of expenditure details, identifying incorrect charges, and commencement of the charge correction process will ensure our financials are accurate. To review, process, and track sub consultant invoices on various projects.
* Prepare and update project schedules and cost/resource loading them.
* Identify and drive optimizations in planning and execution of projects
* Advise Project Controls Lead and Project Leadership Team of any potential schedule issues and when necessary, provide guidance on corrective action and measures to mitigate any adverse trends.
* Develop and review schedule corrective actions and recovery plans and verify needed actions plans are implemented.
* Review project changes to evaluate detail schedule impact; responsible for quantifying and incorporating the effect and impact of approved changes in the overall schedule stewardship and reporting.
* Monitor and report on schedule implications of changes
* Support project team with ongoing project progress measurement and schedule analysis, reporting, and forecasting activities.
* Develop change management and maintaining change log.
* Support in monitoring of cost developments of engineering/vendors/contractors and develop the cost reports.
* Look for ways to reduce project costs and for ways to improve our work processes.
* Perform price estimation and price budgeting from contract commitment to fit the baseline program
* Provide planning / scheduling, and cost controlling mechanism for all projects which includes variation reporting, monitoring of milestone progress to the preparation of customer billing processes, etc.
* Ensure effective project implementation and utilize productive reports from the creation of WBS with the use of project management system to monitor the status of the project.
* Perform project costing related reporting to the team and management’s review monthly to ensure that expenditures are kept within the project budget.
* Performing and/or managing the analysis of cost and risks for projects with a focus on support of project management.
* Accountable for investment of project cost, and schedule and reports to the Project Manager of one or more projects during the planning and execution phase.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Graduate / Advanced degree in Engineering or other technical disciplines
* Experience in the infrastructure sector or in construction industry is highly preferable, with exposure in site engineering, project management, project planning, project costing, project scheduling, coordination, procurement and construction workflows.
* Knowledge in cost control tools and technics to drive /contribute project financial health, knowledge in Estimation, Project / Cost Controlling, Project Tracking, Project Scheduling
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of interdependency of underlying cost and schedule drivers.
* Demonstrate excellent understanding of the entire system of the business, relationship between productivity vs profitability

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.

We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

title: Fintech - FDI - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Analyst, Global Client Payments
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary**
Global Client Payments reconciles and validates the payments Avalara makes on behalf of clients to tax authorities. Payment volume is growing across every line of business, and the team is investing in stronger reconciliation processes and AI-enabled workflows to support that growth.
  
  
This role owns an established reconciliation process and the month-end close that runs alongside it. Daily reconciliations, exception resolution, and month-end close all run to fixed deadlines that partner teams and clients rely on. The role exists to raise the accuracy and timeliness of reconciliation and to convert manual reconciliation effort into repeatable, AI-supported process that makes the work faster and more reliable.
  
  
**How This Role Elevates Avalara**

* Reduces compliance risk by clearing exceptions and unpaid items within published turnaround targets
* Enhances client experience through accurate, timely reconciliation that reduces notices and penalties
* Improves month-end close reliability through complete, on-time delivery
* Prevents errors from reaching clients by catching breaks in peer reconciliations
* Improves decision quality by applying critical thinking across all reconciliation work
* Strengthens the control environment through current procedures and audit-ready evidence
* Increases operational scale by using AI to surface opportunities to improve reconciliation processes
* Raises team capability through documentation, process improvement, and AI best-practice sharing

**Responsibilities**
What Your Responsibilities Will Be
  
  

* Own daily reconciliations of bank activity against liability records, and clear exceptions within published turnaround targets
* Own month-end reconciliation close and deliver complete, accurate results on deadline
* Own creation and resolution of unpaid items, and keep aging within target
* Review reconciliations completed by other analysts, and catch errors before they impact clients
* Own presented-item and stop-payment decisions, exercising judgment within defined control requirements
* Own standard operating procedure (SOP) documentation, keeping it current and audit-ready
* Identify and implement process and AI-enabled improvements that reduce manual effort or improve accuracy
* Partner cross-functionally on unresolved items, and escalate with a recommendation, not just a problem
* Lead within the team by driving shared work to delivery and keeping peers unblocked
* Raise peer capability through onboarding support, knowledge sharing, and coaching

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**AI Expectations**
This role is built for someone who uses AI to create real leverage in speed, accuracy, insight, and scale.
  
  
How you will show up in the role today
  
  

* Spot opportunities to use AI to surface mismatches, aging patterns, and unpaid item trends faster, and work with the team to test and validate those approaches before they touch live work
* Build reusable prompts for recurring tasks like drafting exception narratives, summarizing unpaid item aging, and formatting variance explanations, and strengthen them through peer input before they become part of the team’s toolkit
* Use AI to assist with SOP drafting, updates, and version comparisons, reducing the time it takes to keep documentation current after process changes
* Validate every AI-generated output against source data before it informs any reconciliation decision, presented-item judgment, or stop-payment action; AI assists; it does not decide

How this role will evolve as AI matures
  
  

* As AI takes on more of the routine matching work, this role will shift toward owning the exception logic itself, defining the rules, thresholds, and escalation criteria that AI workflows operate within
* The analyst will increasingly serve as a quality control layer over AI outputs, spotting drift, validating edge cases, and flagging where AI confidence should not be trusted
* Process improvement will evolve from one-off efficiency gains to identifying where AI can be consistently embedded in recurring reconciliation tasks
* Documentation and knowledge transfer will carry more weight, as well-structured process knowledge enables more consistent execution across the team and makes AI assistance more accurate

Candidates who can demonstrate this mindset, using AI confidently today while thinking clearly about where the role is heading, will stand out.
  
  
**Bar Raiser**
This role exists to raise the bar for the team, not just maintain current state or restore capacity. The right candidate doesn’t just do the job well; they introduce new practices, make the people around them better, and leave the process more capable than they found it.
  
  
What bar-raising looks like in this role
  
  

* Structured thinking that makes complex problems legible. This person doesn’t just resolve exceptions; they diagnose why the exception occurred, whether it signals a broader pattern, and what process change would prevent recurrence. When they escalate, they bring a clear problem statement, the relevant data, and a recommended path forward. When they document a process, someone else can follow it without asking a follow-up question.
* Introduces new practices, not just better execution of old ones. They don’t wait to be asked to improve something. They see a manual step in month-end close, assess the control risk, and come with a proposal. They identify an AI workflow that eliminates a recurring data-prep task and pilot it with sign-off. They set a new standard for what “good” looks like in reconciliation.
* Raises the floor of the team, not just their own ceiling. Their onboarding support, knowledge sharing, and documentation make junior analysts measurably more independent. Peers escalate less to the manager because this person is a reliable first resource. The team’s collective output improves because of how they show up.
* Drives better decisions through better information. They surface insights from reconciliation data that inform business decisions upstream — patterns in unpaid items, jurisdictions with recurring exceptions, or trends that signal a process control failure before it becomes a customer issue.

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience in treasury, finance, or accounting
* Demonstrated experience in data analysis, independent problem-solving, and reconciliation
* Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including the ability to translate technical detail into business terms
* Experience working within an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with internal and external partners
* Proven ability to deliver results under pressure and against tight deadlines
* High quality-control standards and strong attention to detail
* Understanding of both accounting guidance and the mechanics of execution
* Collaborative working style with the ability to adapt as business priorities shift

**Preferred**

* MBA with a concentration in Finance
* Demonstrated hands-on AI use that produced measurable, documented improvement
* Experience with payment processing, bank reconciliation, or tax remittance workflows
* Experience with NetSuite
* Familiarity with building or refining process documentation and SOPs
* Experience coaching or mentoring junior analysts in a finance or accounting context

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

We are seeking a Senior Specialist to join our team Commercial Analytics team. The mission for the team is to provide analytical and reporting support to Investment Management business stakeholders, including sales distribution, finance, client engagement, and marketing teams. This entails the end-to-end management of the data and reporting process. The role requires the ability to work through tight deadlines and solution problems independently. The ideal candidate can think through problems and challenge existing approaches when necessary to improve results and efficiency of team deliverables. This role is located in Pune.
  
  
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

description:
