title: Senior Financial Systems Analyst - CPM / Financial Planning Systems
description:
**Education :**
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; Master's degree or relevant finance/CPM certification preferred.
  
  
**Experience :**
At least 5 - 8 years of experience in financial systems, corporate finance, or FP&A, including planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, data analysis, or financial systems administration; experience in a global organization preferred.
  
  

* Strong understanding of financial concepts, including P&L, cost center/account structures, planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting.
* Hands-on experience with CPM/EPM platforms such as CCH Tagetik, OneStream, Oracle EPM/Hyperion, Anaplan, SAP Analytics Cloud Planning, Adaptive Planning, or similar.
* Experience with ERP and financial systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar enterprise platforms, including upstream and downstream financial data flows.
* Proven ability to configure and administer complex financial system components including dimensions, hierarchies, workflows, business rules, metadata, and security.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently assess complex issues, evaluate multiple sources of information, and drive root-cause resolution.
* Experience leading or coordinating system enhancements, testing/UAT, upgrades, releases, or finance transformation workstreams with minimal guidance.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, financial modelling, data analysis, and reporting tools; experience with Power BI or similar analytics tools is a plus.
* Strong business acumen, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate finance requirements into system solutions and build consensus across teams.

**Technical Skills :**

* Strong working knowledge of CPM/EPM platforms for planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting; CCH Tagetik experience preferred.
* Advanced system configuration and administration skills across metadata, dimensions, hierarchies, workflows, business rules, user roles, access, and permissions.
* Experience with data integration and transformation, including ERP connectivity, mappings, validations, reconciliations, and financial data import/export management.
* Ability to perform system monitoring, issue diagnosis, maintenance, testing, release support, and controls to maintain system reliability and data integrity.
* Advanced reporting and data analysis capabilities; knowledge of SQL, TGKML, scripting, or automation/data integration tools is a strong plus.

**Soft Skills :**

* Independent and accountable professional who can manage complex activities with minimal guidance and exercise sound judgment.
* Strategic and analytical thinker who connects financial process needs with scalable system design, governance, and controls.
* Strong problem solver who anticipates risks, performs root-cause analysis, and drives practical, sustainable improvements.
* Effective communicator who can explain difficult financial and technical concepts clearly to both business and technology stakeholders.
* Collaborative influencer who builds trust, works across global cross-functional teams, and helps establish alignment and consensus.
* Proactive and adaptable team member who acts as a resource for colleagues, manages competing priorities, and thrives in a dynamic environment.

**Essential Duties**
**System Management & Governance**

* Own advanced configuration, administration, and ongoing support of CPM/EPM and related financial systems supporting the Health organization.
* Administer user access, roles, permissions, hierarchies, workflows, metadata, business rules, and other system configurations, ensuring appropriate governance and controls.
* Monitor system performance, scheduled processes, data loads, and integrations; investigate complex issues and coordinate timely resolution across Finance, IT, vendors, and business teams.
* Lead system maintenance, updates, regression testing, UAT, and release activities while maintaining detailed system documentation, SOPs, and support materials.

**Planning, Forecasting & Reporting**

* Support and enhance planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting processes, ensuring financial data is accurate, complete, and available according to business timelines.
* Partner with Finance and FP&A stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze financial and process needs, and develop management reports, dashboards, and system solutions.
* Perform advanced data and variance analysis, reconcile financial information across systems, and translate business requirements into configurations, validations, automations, and data flows.

**Continuous Improvement & Project Leadership**

* Identify and implement opportunities to automate, simplify, and standardize financial processes, controls, system configurations, and reporting.
* Lead or independently manage workstreams for CPM/EPM enhancements, integrations, upgrades, implementations, and other finance technology initiatives.
* Apply best practices and lessons learned to improve system reliability, scalability, user experience, and governance across Finance Shared Services and supported business teams.

**Stakeholder Management & User Support**

* Provide comprehensive support to finance system users, including complex issue resolution, guidance, training, and knowledge transfer.
* Coordinate with Health Finance, Shared Services, IT, external partners, and other stakeholders to align priorities, requirements, solution design, and delivery timelines.
* Serve as a subject matter resource for colleagues and leadership by providing clear status updates, metrics, recommendations, and insights on financial systems and improvement initiatives.

title: Principal, Capital Planning & Portfolio Lead, Infrastructure Services
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Principal Technology Portfolio Lead is a senior strategic leadership role responsible for overseeing the planning, forecasting, governance, optimization, and financial management of the organization's technology portfolio across Infrastructure, Cloud, Applications, Cybersecurity, Data Platforms, and Enterprise Technology Services.
  
  
This role serves as the critical bridge between Technology Leadership, Finance, Vendor Management, Procurement, and Business stakeholders to ensure effective management of both Capital (CapEx) and Operating Expenses (OpEx). The individual will drive financial transparency, portfolio optimization, investment prioritization, cost efficiency initiatives, and long-range technology financial planning.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen with deep understanding of technology domains including cloud computing, infrastructure, applications, software engineering, software licensing, hardware lifecycle management, data center services, and managed services. They must possess the ability to influence senior leaders and drive strategic decisions through data-driven insights and innovative financial management practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Portfolio Financial Management**

* Own and manage the end-to-end technology financial portfolio across Infrastructure, Cloud, Application Development, Cybersecurity, Data Platforms, and Enterprise Services.
* Lead annual budget planning, quarterly forecasting, monthly financial reviews, and multi-year strategic financial planning processes.
* Develop and maintain technology investment roadmaps aligned with business and enterprise technology strategies.
* Create financial models to support investment decisions, business cases, technology transformations, and modernization initiatives.
* Partner with technology executives to optimize allocation of technology spend and resources across strategic priorities.

**CapEx and OpEx Governance**

* Establish governance frameworks for technology capital and operating expenditures.
* Monitor portfolio performance against approved budgets and forecasts.
* Drive financial accountability among portfolio owners and technology leaders.
* Provide variance analysis, trend reporting, risk assessments, and remediation plans.
* Ensure compliance with corporate financial controls, capitalization policies, and audit requirements.

**Cloud and Infrastructure Financial Optimization**

* Lead cloud financial management (FinOps) practices across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Drive optimization of cloud consumption, reserved instances, licensing utilization, and infrastructure costs.
* Analyze technology spending patterns across compute, storage, networking, SaaS, platform services, and managed services.
* Identify cost reduction opportunities while maintaining service quality and operational resilience.
* Support technology modernization initiatives with robust financial analysis and return-on-investment assessments.

**Hardware, Software and Licensing Management**

* Develop strategic plans for hardware refresh cycles, infrastructure modernization, and asset lifecycle management.
* Partner with Procurement and Vendor Management teams to optimize software contracts and licensing strategies.
* Monitor software license utilization and ensure cost-effective licensing models.
* Evaluate vendor proposals, renewals, and technology investments from a financial and business value perspective.
* Drive enterprise-wide software rationalization and optimization programs.

**Strategic Planning and Technology Investments**

* Facilitate investment prioritization across competing technology initiatives.
* Support executive governance forums responsible for portfolio review and investment approvals.
* Build executive-level dashboards and KPI frameworks to measure portfolio performance.
* Develop scenario planning and financial forecasting models to support strategic technology decisions.
* Provide recommendations to optimize technology ROI and business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, Technology Executives, Finance Leaders, and Business Partners.
* Collaborate with PMOs, Engineering Leaders, Infrastructure Teams, Cloud Teams, Application Leaders, Procurement, and Finance functions.
* Present financial insights, recommendations, and portfolio performance updates to senior leadership.
* Drive alignment between technology strategy, financial objectives, and enterprise priorities.

**Process Improvement and Automation**

* Modernize technology financial management practices through automation and analytics.
* Drive adoption of portfolio management and financial governance tools.
* Implement data-driven reporting, forecasting, and planning capabilities.
* Leverage AI, automation, and analytics platforms to improve forecasting accuracy and financial decision-making.
* Champion continuous improvement across portfolio governance and financial operations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 15+ years of experience in technology portfolio management, technology finance, strategic planning, PMO leadership, or technology operations.
* 5+ years managing large-scale technology budgets and investment portfolios exceeding $50M+ annually.
* Strong experience managing both CapEx and OpEx within enterprise technology organizations.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with senior technology and finance executives.
* Advanced financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and business case development skills.
* Strong understanding of technology cost structures across infrastructure, cloud, applications, software engineering, cybersecurity, and enterprise platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA, CFA, CPA, PMP, PgMP, or equivalent professional certification.
* Experience within Financial Services, Banking, Asset Management, Insurance, or highly regulated industries.
* Knowledge of FinOps, TBM (Technology Business Management), ITFM (IT Financial Management), and Portfolio Governance frameworks.
* Experience managing global technology portfolios across multiple regions.
* Familiarity with Agile Portfolio Management and Product Funding models.

**Technical Exposure**
**Infrastructure & Operations:**
Data Center / Colo, Network, Storage, Compute, DB, Resiliency, Cloud Platforms
  
  
**Applications & Software:**
SaaS, PaaS, Licensing Models, Software Asset Management
  
  
**Financial & Portfolio Tools:**
Apptio (TBM), ServiceNow SPM/ITBM
**,**
Power BI
**,**
Tableau
**,**
Anaplan, MS Excel Advanced, etc.
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Strategic Financial Planning
* Technology Portfolio Management
* Executive Communication
* Business Partnership
* Financial Analysis & Forecasting
* Investment Governance
* Cost Optimization
* Vendor & Contract Management
* Data Analytics
* Risk Management
* Leadership & Influence
* Program and Portfolio Governance
* Negotiation & Stakeholder Management

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Accounting Associate - Project Accounting
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
This position is fully responsible for the project accounting & billing process, including responding to Management inquiries, verifying employee’s billable time with the time recording system & making sure that revenue leakages are avoided; front face with Operations staff on this account and making sure that the process is compliant with the Company Procedures & prescribed Accounting Practices & standards.
  
  

* Set up new projects, open and close time classes in company system (ORACLE), apply transaction controls, budget, payment terms and configure the contract in the Project Accounting System.
* Analyse and understand the contract terms & conditions and accordingly ensure that correct billing is done to the client for T&M and Fixed Price projects.
* Understand the impact of price escalation or change notices as per contract conditions and ensure that there is no loss of revenue for the company.
* Effectively communicate with Project Managers (PM) and Principals-in-Charge (PIC), regarding contract documents, change orders and other contract modifications, approvals, and any additional services-related to billing.
* Have a good understanding of accounting standards for revenue recognition.
* Prepare final invoice package containing draft and final invoices for all billable projects, including all applicable backup for approval by the Accounting Supervisor.
* Ensure timelines for raising and submission of invoices to the clients.
* Research any unbilled issues to optimize the billing possibilities for the billing period.
* Maintain folders / files for all projects, with all the appropriate documents, including expenses, consultant invoices, and monthly invoices, in accordance with standard procedures.
* Work with the Accounts Receivable team member to reconcile variances that occur in the application of cash.
* Work with Accounts Payable team members where certain expenses are billable to clients at actuals.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Location:**
Kharadi, Pune

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Department:**
Finance & Accounts

**Employment Type:**
Full-time | Work from Office

About QKS Group

QKS Group is a global strategic advisory and market research firm, working with leading technology companies across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other international markets.

Role Overview

We are looking for a
**Senior Accountant with 3–5 years of relevant experience**
to manage day-to-day accounting operations, taxation, financial reconciliations, international invoicing, and statutory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have strong accounting fundamentals, practical experience with Zoho Books and Excel, and the ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities with accuracy and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Accounting & Bookkeeping**

* Manage daily accounting transactions, journal entries, ledger maintenance, and reconciliations.
* Maintain accurate and update books of accounts using Zoho Books.
* Handle accounts payable, vendor payments, reimbursements, and expense accounting.
* Assist in monthly and annual book closures.
* Prepare and maintain supporting financial schedules and documentation.

**2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Handle GST calculations, reconciliations, and return filings, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.
* Manage TDS deductions, payments, quarterly returns, and reconciliations.
* Assist with income tax, advance tax calculations, and other statutory requirements.
* Maintain compliance calendars and ensure timely completion of applicable filings.
* Coordinate with external Chartered Accountants and auditors.

**3. Client Invoicing & Receivables**

* Prepare and maintain invoices for domestic and international clients.
* Track outstanding receivables and maintain customer ageing reports.
* Coordinate with internal teams regarding invoicing and payment status.
* Reconcile foreign inward remittances and maintain necessary supporting documentation.
* Account for foreign exchange gains and losses.

**4. Banking & Financial Reconciliation**

* Perform regular bank reconciliations and monitor financial transactions.
* Maintain records of fixed deposits, loans, investments, and other banking transactions.
* Coordinate with banks for routine financial documentation and transactions.
* Prepare weekly reports on bank balances, outstanding payments, and upcoming obligations.

**5. Payroll & Employee Accounting**

* Assist with monthly payroll processing and salary-related accounting.
* Maintain employee reimbursement and expense records.
* Coordinate with HR for payroll inputs, final settlements, and applicable statutory deductions.

**6. MIS & Financial Reporting**

* Prepare monthly MIS reports covering revenue, expenses, receivables, and cash flow.
* Assist in preparing Profit & Loss statements and Balance Sheet schedules.
* Track monthly expenses and highlight discrepancies or unusual transactions.
* Provide accounting reports and financial information to management as required.

**7. Audit Support**

* Coordinate documentation for statutory and tax audits.
* Prepare reconciliations, ledgers, and supporting schedules requested by auditors.
* Assist in resolving audit observations and accounting discrepancies.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* B.Com or M.Com degree; CA Inter or CMA Inter preferred but not mandatory.
* **3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience**
  , preferably with a service-based, IT, consulting, or professional services company.
* Strong working knowledge of GST, TDS, and Indian accounting practices.
* Proficiency in Zoho Booksand MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and reconciliations.
* Experience handling international invoices and foreign currency transactions will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of financial statements and accounting reconciliations.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with management, HR, banks, and external auditors.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented accounting professional who can take ownership of routine accounting operations, ensure timely compliance, maintain accurate financial records, and provide reliable financial information to management.

The candidate should be comfortable working in a growing organization with international clients and multiple financial transactions.

description:

**Title And Summary**
Senior Specialist, Finance Services
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Global Business Solution Center’s (GBSC) mission is to be the partner of choice with stakeholders across Mastercard, enabling business operations efficiency, productivity, and growth. With over 1,100 professionals delivering more than 200 solutions across 10 locations, GBSC is a powerhouse of innovation and strategic partnerships that combines operational excellence with a vision of what’s next.
  
  
The GBSC Finance Helpdesk plays a critical role in enabling consistent, customer-focused support across Finance-related service channels. The team is responsible for effective inquiry management, operational governance, knowledge management, process adherence, and digital enablement across areas such as Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Travel & Expense, Purchase Order Processing, and related business support processes.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Specialist to support and strengthen Knowledge Base Management within GBSC Finance Helpdesk. This role will focus on maintaining accurate, accessible, and well-governed knowledge content that enables faster resolution, improves service consistency, reduces repeat inquiries, supports digital workforce capabilities, and feeds future-state self-service options. The role will partner closely with process owners, SMEs, service desk teams, and enablement partners to ensure SOPs, KBAs, routing logic, decision trees, chatbot content, and self-service knowledge remain current, compliant, and aligned to business needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Knowledge Base Management & Governance
  
  

* Lead the ongoing review, maintenance, and enhancement of GBSC Finance Helpdesk knowledge articles, SOPs, KBAs, FAQs, templates, decision trees, chatbot inputs, and process documentation.
* Ensure knowledge content is accurate, clear, searchable, user-friendly, and aligned to current process, policy, compliance, and control requirements.
* Establish and maintain governance routines for article ownership, review frequency, version control, approvals, retirement, and refresh cycles.
* Partner with SMEs and process owners to convert tribal knowledge, recurring issue patterns, and process updates into structured knowledge content.
* Support annual and periodic SOP/KBA reviews to maintain documentation completeness, audit readiness, and operational consistency.

Helpdesk Service Enablement
  
  

* Enable frontline Helpdesk teams by ensuring agents have access to reliable knowledge content, standard responses, escalation guidance, and troubleshooting steps.
* Identify knowledge gaps based on ticket drivers, reopen trends, quality findings, escalations, aging, repeat inquiries, and self-service failure points.
* Collaborate with manager and trainers to embed knowledge usage into onboarding, refresher training, coaching, and quality review routines.
* Support standardization of responses and resolution steps across Finance Helpdesk queues to improve customer experience and reduce dependency on individual expertise.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Analyze ticket trends, recurring queries, process defects, and customer pain points to recommend knowledge improvements, digital workforce use cases, and self-service opportunities.
* Partner with operational teams to document process changes, automation impacts, routing updates, and control enhancements in a timely manner.
* Contribute to initiatives that improve first contact resolution, reduce ticket rework, prevent avoidable reopens, improve agent productivity, and increase case deflection through self-service.
* Support governance reporting by tracking knowledge health, documentation coverage, review completion, usage trends, self-service readiness, and improvement actions.

Digital Workforce & Self-Service Enablement
  
  

* Support optimization of Helpdesk tools, knowledge repositories, self-service portals, AI/Copilot capabilities, dashboards, workflow solutions, and digital workforce channels.
* Partner with technology, data governance, and transformation teams to improve knowledge discoverability, article quality, automation readiness, chatbot accuracy, and case deflection.
* Assist in validating knowledge content for AI-enabled quality review, chatbot responses, automated ticket routing, digital workforce support, and other digital service enhancements.
* Ensure knowledge content is structured and reusable so it can feed self-service options, virtual agents, digital assistants, guided help, and future-state service platforms.
* Ensure content standards support a consistent customer experience across channels such as Remedy, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, self-service portals, and digital workforce touchpoints.

Compliance, Risk & Controls
  
  

* Ensure knowledge documentation supports business controls, audit requirements, data handling standards, and process compliance expectations.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow corporate security, data governance, and access management requirements when documenting and sharing process information.
* Escalate documentation gaps, outdated guidance, or control risks to the appropriate process owner or leadership team.

**All About You**

* Strong understanding of service desk operations, knowledge management, process documentation, digital workforce enablement, self-service content management, and operational governance.
* Experience supporting Finance operations, shared services, or helpdesk environments across areas such as AP, AR, T&E or related functions would be a plus.
* Ability to translate complex process information into clear, concise, searchable, and reusable knowledge content that supports both agent-assisted and self-service channels.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, root causes, knowledge gaps, digital enablement opportunities, and continuous improvement actions.
* High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and ability to manage multiple documentation priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with SMEs, operations teams, technology teams, transformation teams, and leadership.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, SharePoint, ticketing systems, reporting dashboards, and digital collaboration platforms; experience with AI/Copilot, virtual agents, or automation-enabled knowledge solutions is preferred.
* Customer-focused, collaborative, control-oriented, and committed to improving service quality, self-service adoption, and digital support effectiveness through strong knowledge governance.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The Senior Accountant is responsible for managing financial close, general ledger, balance sheet, and reporting processes in compliance with U.S. GAAP, company policies, and regulatory requirements. The role ensures accurate and timely financial reporting, supports budgeting and forecasting, and collaborates across departments to maintain operational efficiency, internal controls, and compliance. This role covers key areas of full cycle general ledger accounting, including but not limited to cash & bank, selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses, revenue and cost of goods accounting, operation accounting, intercompany transactions, asset management, balance sheet reconciliations, financial analysis, and tax.
  
  
This position will be responsible for performing and reviewing end-to-end Record to Report (R2R) processes to ensure compliance with the accounting standards (U.S. GAAP), internal controls, and company policies, while driving process improvement and operational excellence across all R2R functions.

* Execute monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities to ensure timely and accurate financial results.
* Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and adjustments.
* Analyze trial balances and financial results, investigate variances and resolve discrepancies.
* Prepare financial statements, P&L packages, and management reports with clear variance explanations.
* Prepare local statutory, governmental, and other external reports.
* Partner with FP&A and department leaders to support budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis.
* Maintain accounting records in accordance with U.S. GAAP, corporate policies, and the chart of accounts.

description:
Senior Revenue Accountant Finance

AppZen is an AI-first automation platform for finance teams, covering the full spend-to-pay lifecycle — from invoice processing and expense auditing to accounts payable and corporate card review. Our AI platform integrates with customers' existing systems to reduce manual effort, errors, fraud, and compliance risk, giving finance and accounting teams the tools to operate more strategically and scale without adding headcount.

Role Summary

As a member of the Finance team, the Senior Revenue Accountant will own operational revenue accounting and compliance at AppZen.This role reviews, analyzes, and approves customer contracts and revenue arrangements under ASC 606, drives the month-end revenue close, and partners closely with AR & Collections, Deal Desk, GTM, and FP&A to ensure revenue, deferred revenue, and receivable balances are accurate, well-documented, and audit-ready. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, motivated, and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This is initially an individual contributor role, with the expectation that it will grow into a managerial position as the Revenue Accounting function scales.

Responsibilities

• Manage daily revenue accounting operations — review, analyze, and approve customer contracts using the ASC 606 framework and company policy for revenue recognition.

• Review and approve revenue arrangements for allocations, concessions, and similar items to ensure accurate revenue recognition in compliance with ASC 606.

• Perform the month-end revenue close process, including revenue-related account reconciliations and journal entries for revenue, deferred revenue, and unbilled receivables.

• Perform quarterly CECL aging analysis to ensure consistent application of ASC 326, and partner with the AR & Collections Lead to develop and report key AR metrics for management reporting.

• Work closely with the AR team to resolve complex AR and collections issues.

• Perform regular month-end close flux analysis, identifying and explaining significant variances in revenue and accounts receivable balances to support financial integrity and management decision-making.

• Perform and maintain the annual SSP (standalone selling price) analysis, including management of the item master and fair value records.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with GTM, Deal Desk, and AR teams to resolve issues.

• Support revenue accounting system initiatives, including implementation, testing, and optimization.

• Prepare audit schedules and assist with coordination of the year-end audit with external auditors. • Maintain the highest documentation standards.

• Partner with FP&A to provide inputs for revenue forecasts as needed.

• Prepare detailed revenue packages for management and the audit committee/Board as requested.

• Participate in special projects as they arise.

What You Need

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Strong understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.

• 7+ years of experience in revenue accounting, and full-cycle accounts receivable, ideally for SaaS companies.

• Knowledge of US GAAP revenue accounting, specifically revenue from customer contracts (ASC 606), is required.

• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage effectively through ambiguity and complexity.

• Consistently meets deadlines, prioritizes appropriately, and remains flexible.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Workspace applications.

• Highly motivated, energetic self-starter and strategic thinker.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to build relationships within and outside the Finance team.

• Experience with NetSuite ERP, NetSuite ARM, and Salesforce is required.

Things That Make a Difference

● Familiarity with US sales tax regulations and requirements.

● Proven expertise managing full-cycle accounts receivable processes.

● Knowledge of Order Processing.

● Hands-on experience navigating customer procurement portals, including Coupa and Ariba.

title: Team Lead (Finance)
description:
**Job Purpose**
Oversees and guides an assigned team of accounting analysts & associates, ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of financial services in line with client service level agreements (SLAs) and quality standards. With a strong focus on managing both financial and non-financial transactions, implementing control measures, and facilitating effective communication among stakeholders. The Team Lead drives team performance, maintains accountability for KPIs, and leads initiatives to optimize processes, enhance accuracy, and deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
**Key Result Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily accounting operations, maintaining real-time communication mechanisms to keep all relevant parties informed and aligned on task progress and priority items.
* Ensure adherence to client SLAs, monitoring team performance closely. Identify and implement corrective actions as needed to address any deviations from timelines, accuracy, or quality standards
* Establish and implement controls and review mechanisms to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all deliverables. Regularly evaluate workflows to identify and correct potential gaps in compliance or accuracy
* Direct the preparation, validation, and reconciliation of financial statements, including client and supplier accounts, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Build and maintain clear, effective communication channels with stakeholders. Conduct periodic reviews with managers and key stakeholders to facilitate information exchange, address concerns, and provide updates on team performance.
* Coordinate and manage the timely closure of monthly, quarterly, and annual books, ensuring that all financial statements and reports are delivered within established timelines.
* Identify, develop, and lead process improvement initiatives that drive accuracy, efficiency, and productivity within the team. Champion automation and workflow enhancements to streamline operations.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide feedback, and establish development plans to enhance team capabilities and motivate high performance.
* Actively coach and support team members in both work-related tasks and broader professional development. Provide guidance, feedback, and resources to foster both technical skills and personal growth.
* Prepare and review regular and ad hoc management reports, ensuring accuracy and insights that support data-driven decisions by senior leadership.

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field.
  
  
Proficiency in MS Office applications (Advanced Excel is a must) and any accounting software
  
  
**Work Experience**
6 to 8 years of accounting experience, with at least 2 years in a team leadership role within a BPO or shared services environment.
  
  
Strong knowledge of accounting principles, reconciliation processes, reporting standards, and operational best practices.
  
  
Exceptional analytical skills, attention to detail, and proactive problem-solving abilities.
  
  
Demonstrated experience in meeting and managing SLAs, with a proven ability to take corrective action when needed.
  
  
Experience in establishing control frameworks, conducting performance reviews, and supporting process improvement.
  
  
Ability to coach, guide and support team members in both professional and personal development.
  
  
Familiarity with international accounting standards and BPO-specific client requirements.

title: SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
description:
Job Description: Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
  
  
Position Overview
  
  

* Position: Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
* Experience Required: 8 to 10+ years
* Location / Mode: PAN India / Hybrid
* Project Type: Implementation, Roll-outs, Support, Change Requests, and Enhancements

Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic
**Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant**
with a strong track record of end-to-end implementations and business process re-engineering. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise across core and advanced SAP CO modules, exceptional stakeholder communication skills, and hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA environments. You will lead requirement gathering, solution building, gap analysis, and month-end closing cycles while coordinating closely with technical teams.
  
  
**Mandatory Requirements & Core Skills**

* Experience: 8–10+ years of cumulative IT experience specializing in SAP Controlling (CO).
* Communication: EXCELLENT verbal and written communication skills with proven ability in client-facing roles, blueprinting, and user training.
* SAP S/4HANA Knowledge: Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA differences compared to ECC (e.g., Universal Journal integration, Material Ledger enhancements, CO-PA architecture).
* Project Lifecycle: Hands-on participation in at least 2+ full-cycle implementations, roll-outs, or major support/enhancement projects from requirement gathering to Go-Live.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Core SAP CO Modules:

+ General Controlling, Cost Center Accounting (CO-OM-CCA), and Profit Center Accounting (EC-PCA).
+ Product Costing (CO-PC) covering Make-to-Stock (MTS) and Make-to-Order (MTO) scenarios.
+ Material Ledger (ML) and profitability analysis (CO-PA), including Report Painter, CO-PA Realignment, and Top-Down Distribution.

* Month-End Closing Excellence: Expert execution and troubleshooting of month-end closing tasks in CO, including Work in Process (WIP) calculation, Variance Analysis, and Order/Project Settlement.
* Specialized CO Scenarios:

+ Overhead management (Overhead keys, Overhead groups).
+ Advanced costing methods: Additive costing, Job costing, Batch costing, Mixed costing, Joint product, By-product, and Co-product costing.
+ Origin groups and Auxiliary Cost Component structures.

* Cross-Functional Integration: Seamless integration of SAP CO with FI, MM, SD, PP, and PM modules, alongside integration with BW or BI.
* Project Delivery & Methodology:

+ Lead Business Process Re-engineering (BPR), Solution Building, Blueprinting, and GAP Analysis.
+ Design and execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and prepare comprehensive user manuals and training documentation.
+ Manage and prioritize multiple assignments simultaneously to meet rigorous delivery schedules.

* Technical Coordination & Interfaces: Collaborate with technical teams for custom object development, and handle interface configurations including RFC connections and Background Job Tools.

Accountant

**About Us**

1XL is a Dubai-based company focused on empowering individuals and organisations through growth, innovation, and success. We inspire individuals and organisations to reach their full potential through tailored, market-proven solutions.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accountant to manage accounting operations for our UAE group entities remotely and our India entity. The role involves maintaining books of accounts in Tally Prime, handling bank reconciliations, supporting taxation and payroll compliance, preparing financial reports, and coordinating with the Dubai team, auditors, and other stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. UAE Group Entities**

* Record purchases, sales, receipts, payments, and journal entries in Tally Prime with proper supporting documentation.
* Prepare monthly bank reconciliations and resolve unmatched transactions.
* Maintain tenant rent, post-dated cheque (PDC), and vendor payment trackers.
* Prepare VAT working schedules, including input and output VAT registers, for review by the Dubai team.
* Support month-end closing activities, including accruals, prepayments, depreciation, and inter-company reconciliations.
* Prepare audit and Corporate Tax schedules as required.

**2. India Entity**

* Maintain books of accounts in Tally Prime and ensure accurate recording of financial transactions.
* Handle TDS calculations, quarterly returns, and issuance of TDS certificates.
* Support GST compliance, monthly payroll processing, PF, and Professional Tax.
* Track foreign inward remittances, Foreign Inward Remittance Certificates (FIRCs), and export-of-service invoicing.
* Coordinate with statutory auditors and assist with ROC/LLP annual filings.
* Prepare monthly bank balance, cash flow, expense, and other financial reports for management.

**3. Reporting and Coordination**

* Maintain accurate accounting records, ledgers, and financial trackers.
* Ensure timely completion of reconciliations, reports, and compliance activities.
* Coordinate with the Dubai finance team and other stakeholders for accounting information and clarifications.
* Maintain proper documentation and support audit requirements.

**Key Skills Required**

* **Qualification:**

  B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter or equivalent.
* **Experience:**

  Minimum 2+ years of practical accounting experience.
* Hands-on experience with Tally Prime and good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and SUMIFS.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, payroll, PF, and Professional Tax.
* Knowledge of UAE VAT and Corporate Tax will be an added advantage; training will be provided where required.
* Good written English communication skills for daily coordination with the Dubai team.
* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and time management.
* Pune-based candidates or candidates willing to relocate to Pune.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Monthly bank reconciliations completed by the 5th working day.
* Timely statutory filings with minimal errors and no avoidable late fees.
* Accurate accounting records and financial schedules submitted to Dubai within agreed deadlines.
* No unexplained or unreconciled suspense balances at month-end.

**Selection Process**

1. **Technical Interview:**

   Video call to assess accounting knowledge and relevant experience.
2. **Practical Accounting Test:**

   Approximately 60 minutes, covering accounting entries, Tally Prime, Excel, and reconciliations.
3. **Final Discussion and Offer:**

   Discussion regarding role expectations, salary, and joining availability.

* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

* Good communication skills
* Should have Project management capabilities.

description:

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
  
  
© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
**Role –**
The VMC FP&A Analyst reports to the BU FP&A VMC Team Lead and works closely with the BU Head, BU FP&A, R2R, Costing Analyst, IBP, ISC and Commercial Navigators / Controller, creating an impact by providing high value adding analysis on variable manufacturing cost (VMC) of the respective BU at various levels (BU, Performance Cell, Region, Country, Legal Entity, Site, Customer-Material to the ISC and Commercial association.
  
  
**VMC CoE End to End Scope:**
The VMC CoE Analyst collaborates with BU finance leadership to provide a detailed overview of VMC development, using advanced data platforms like CFIN, CRYSTAL, Power BI, Alteryx, and SAP BI. They identify cost variance drivers, conduct root cause analysis, and work with other pillars to implement corrective actions. The Analyst also supports future cost planning for critical pricing decisions.
  
  
As a reliable business partner, the Analyst identifies and flags process and system related issues, ensuring adherence to accounting standards and AkzoNobel’s P&L guidance (PLENT). They contribute to key projects and continuously improve processes through CI initiatives.
  
  
Candidates should be open to learning new skills and flexible in exploring new ways of working. AkzoNobel promotes a dynamic work culture with a focus on technology adoption to stay ahead of the curve. Analysts are expected to prioritize skill development to keep pace with market and competitor advancements, such as AI and Automation.
  
  
**Key Activities**

* Planning (QRF + Budget):
* Budget Preparation: Prepare budget templates, gather inputs, and load FLM data; run validation checks and resolve data issues.
* Rolling Forecast: Update drivers and post approved manual adjustments; ensure documentation and version control.
* Forecast Translation: Upload and reconcile forecast data in HFM; resolve validation errors under guidance.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Collect inputs from Demand, Data Science, Costing, and Procurement FP&A; track submissions to closure.
* Cost Trend Packs: Generate cost-trend reports vs PY/BUD/QRF; prepare variance tables and initial commentary.
* VMC Bridge Build: Consolidate inputs for PVM bridge and co-ordinate with HRT; validate mappings and ensure consistency with prior versions.
* Strategic Business Support:
* Variance Packs: Prepare MEC variance packs and waterfall charts; summarize drivers for review.
* A06 Preparation: Populate A06 templates; compare to prior periods and fix mapping issues.
* KPI Dashboard: Refresh KPI dashboards (VMC, VMC/L); run data-quality checks and highlight outliers.
* PVM Observations: Draft observations from PVM results for VMC Story telling.
* IBP Support: Compile IBP materials, update slides, record minutes and action owners
* Inventory Revaluation: Calculate RMPI-based forecast impact; maintain workings and assumptions repository.
* Data & Process Integrity (System hygiene, process hygiene):
* Data Hygiene Monitoring: Run exception/integrity reports; flag anomalies (e.g., not-in-use materials) to owners.
* RCA Support: Provide data extracts and trend summaries for RCAs; track action status.
* Gap Ticketing: Raise system/process gap tickets and follow up to resolution.
* Process Improvements:
* Product Cost Checks: Validate BOM/routing and cost splits; flag anomalies to costing.
* CI & Automation: Build macros/Power Query/Power BI measures; document steps and handover notes.
* System Reconciliations: Execute reconciliation scripts across HFM/CFIN/Crystal/SAP; log and categorize issues.
* Digital Tool Usage: Adopt approved AI/digital tools; provide structured feedback.
* Data Standards: Apply naming conventions and data definitions consistently.
* Project Support:
* Project Documentation: Maintain project trackers, timelines, and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependency) logs for assigned initiatives.
* Data Provisioning: Extract, cleanse, and provision datasets for project charters and ad hoc analyses.

**Education**

* Proven work experience “5 to 7 years” in a strategic financial analysis role is essential.
* Qualified chartered or cost accountant or similar equivalent professional competency.
* Experience in large scale manufacturing industry/GBS/GCC. Leveraging deep industry knowledge to enhance financial analysis, cost management, and strategic planning.
* Focus on stakeholder management (e.g. BU Head of Finance, Head of FP&A, Reg Proc Director, Comm, ISC Navigators, Acc Controller, R2R, etc.) engaging to drive actions that support strategic objectives.
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting, optimize data processes, and provide strategic insights to support high-level decision-making (VMC FP&A team is collectively analyzing Variable Manufacturing Cost of around 6 billion €, BU wise ranging from 0.3 billion € to 1 billion €).
* In-depth knowledge of process order settlement and material ledger runs, familiarity with Inter Company (ICD) transactions, proficiency in managing material master attributes, strong analytical skills for financial reviews, and effective communication skills for managing price variations and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Possess in-depth knowledge of Financial & Cost accounting, Product costing, Transfer pricing, IFRS, Financial Statements, and System accounting flow, with a dynamic and innovative approach to problem-solving.
* Must have experience in a multinational company, demonstrating a proven track record of success. Ability to think outside the box and drive strategic financial initiatives.
* Support in managing external financial reporting & ensuring compliance. Responsibilities include preparing VMC Price Volume Mix reporting and Analysis “A06”.
* Proven experience in managing complex organizational setups. Responsibilities include overseeing intricate financial structures, ensuring seamless integration of financial systems, and optimizing processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

3. Analyze market trends, to identify solutions that meet business needs across the categories in scope
4. Contribute to measurable value creation through sourcing initiatives and supplier engagement that deliver cost savings, improved cash flow, stronger supplier performance, effective risk mitigation, and supplier-led innovation
5. Identify opportunities to optimize supplier footprint, service delivery models, and commercial structures
6. Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and ensure procurement activities support operational priorities
7. Support competitive sourcing processes including RFI and RFP, supplier negotiations, and contract award in line with company procurement policies and governance requirements
8. Assist in supplier performance monitoring through clear service expectations, performance reviews, and issue resolution to ensure reliable service delivery
9. Support contract management and supplier governance to ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms, service levels, and risk requirements, including data privacy considerations and appropriate regard for ESG and supplier diversity
10. Contribute to process simplification and supply base rationalization to reduce complexity, improve service consistency, and strengthen commercial leverage
11. Monitor category spend, supplier concentration, and contract coverage, leveraging digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to identify opportunities for cost control, efficiency, and risk mitigation

* Value delivered across the categories in scope including cost savings, cash improvement, service quality, and risk mitigation, benchmarked against industry standards

* Timely execution of sourcing processes including RFI, RFP, negotiations, and contract implementation
* Supply base effectiveness including appropriate supplier coverage, service consistency, and managed risk exposure
* Effective use of digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to improve spend visibility and process efficiency
* Growing personal capability, engagement, and effectiveness within the Procurement team

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field
* Working knowledge of data analytics tools such as Excel or Power BI as well as AI tools
* Working knowledge of procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba is a plus
* Foundational knowledge or coursework in project management is a plus

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5 years in procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management, including exposure to service-based categories, within global or multi-regional organizations
* Hands-on experience with spend data analysis and procurement analytics, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for category strategy and stakeholder recommendations
* Demonstrated experience supporting category strategies and sourcing initiatives that delivered measurable cost savings, cash flow improvement, stronger supplier performance, effective risk mitigation, and supplier-driven solutions

title: Manager, Controllership - HVACR & Controls EUR
description:
Manager, Controllership - Financial Shared Services
  
  
Johnson Controls is looking for a finance leader to oversee a key function within our financial shared services organization in a business center. This role supports accurate accounting operations, strong controls, and timely financial information that helps the business make sound decisions.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
You will lead a specific accounting function with responsibility for daily, weekly, and monthly activities, team coordination, and the quality of financial output. The role is suited to an experienced accounting professional who can balance operational execution, control discipline, and people leadership in a shared services environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Plan and manage the day-to-day, weekly, and monthly accounting activities for the assigned function.
* Establish and maintain accounting systems, procedures, and controls that support accurate financial information.
* Review reconciliations, journal entries, and related accounting outputs to help ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members responsible for the function.
* Partner with internal finance stakeholders and the broader business center to support service delivery and issue resolution.
* Monitor workflow, priorities, and deadlines to keep accounting activities on track.
* Support audit, compliance, and control requirements as part of the shared services operating model.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and standardization across the function.

How You Will Do It
  
  

* Own the function with accountability for accuracy, timeliness, and follow-through.
* Stay close to the work by understanding daily execution, resolving obstacles quickly, and supporting your team where needed.
* Use clear controls and disciplined reviews to protect the integrity of financial information.
* Look for practical ways to improve processes, reduce rework, and strengthen consistency.
* Work as one team by building trust with finance partners, sharing knowledge, and coaching for performance.

**Qualifications**

* University degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* At least 8 years of progressive experience in accounting, controllership, or financial shared services.
* Experience leading or managing a team in a finance or accounting environment.
* Strong knowledge of accounting processes, reconciliations, journal entries, controls, and close activities.
* Ability to establish accounting systems and processes that support accurate and reliable reporting.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in a shared services, business center, or similar high-volume finance environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and deadlines.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience driving process improvement or standardization initiatives in finance operations.
* Background supporting internal or external audits.
* Experience in a global or multi-site accounting environment.

Why Join Us
  
  
This is an opportunity to lead an important finance function where your work directly supports accuracy, control, and service quality. At Johnson Controls, you will work with a collaborative team environment and have the chance to help strengthen shared services processes while developing the people around you.
  
  
If you are ready to lead with accountability and help improve the finance function, we encourage you to apply.

title: Team Lead, ADM Ops
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.
  
  
As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the
**PFLT Data Operations Team Lead**
is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the team on complex Schedule of Investments (SOI) processing, special asset classes (e.g., crypto/token assets, real estate), and intricate fund accounting mechanics (e.g., PQ reconciliation, derived metric calculations, corporate actions).
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex extraction errors across pipeline stages and front-end verification checks.
* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Business Consultant COE
description:
**Job Description**
The Business Consultant will be part of the Honeywell AutonomyX Center of Excellence (CoE) based in Pune, India, and will play an active role in developing and executing business consulting activities for Middle East, Turkey, and Central Asia (META) region opportunities, with flexibility to engage other regions depending on workload. This role will combine selective front-office ownership of qualified customer opportunities with back-office business development, analysis, proposal, and value-storyline execution in partnership with the Middle East business consulting team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Business development and selective opportunity leadership for META digital transformation programs for operating companies:
* Co-lead opportunity development for Honeywell AutonomyX and related transformation programs across META, working closely with the Middle East business consulting lead and regional sales teams, including

+ Research customer operating models, business priorities, performance improvement levers, and digital/autonomy transformation opportunities
+ Translate customer challenges into structured consulting problem statements linked to Honeywell and AutonomyX solutions
+ Own preparation of executive engagement materials, value hypotheses, customer narratives, and account-specific storylines for selected pursuits
+ Lead or actively participate in selected customer-facing discussions and workshops, including preparation, facilitation, documentation, and follow-up from Pune or on site when required
+ Own customer-ready material including value propositions, executive summaries, business cases, case studies, and sales enablement content for assigned opportunities
+ Lead preparation and follow-through for selected regional demonstrations, conferences, campaigns, and strategic pursuits

* Drive go-to-market planning inputs, account prioritization, white-space analysis, customer segmentation for Honeywell AutonomyX and Process Automation
* Consulting workshops, studies and execution ownership
* Lead or co-lead scoping of customer diagnostic exercises, workshops, value assessments, and consulting studies for selected META opportunities
* Develop consulting proposals, workshop agendas, data request lists, workplans, interview guides, and analysis frameworks with appropriate regional input
* Coordinate and drive inputs from technical, sales, and solution teams to produce structured consulting deliverables
* Own the development of diagnostic reports, gap analyses, business cases, value roadmaps, maturity assessments, and adoption plans for assigned workstreams
* Drive follow-up actions, maintain opportunity documentation, and lead handover from consulting discovery into sales execution where assigned
* CoE capability building and organizational enablement
* Build and continuously improve repeatable AutonomyX consulting assets, templates, value frameworks, and proposal content within the Pune CoE
* Lead selected internal enablement activities for value-based selling and consulting-led opportunity development across META
* Share best practices, case studies, and reusable methods with regional sales, consulting, and solution teams

**Qualifications**
**Skills and qualifications**

* Prior consulting experience with a leading consulting firm at Associate level or equivalent, including strategy, operations, transformation, digital, or value-creation work. Alternatively MBA from a leading business school
* Prior experience in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, refining, petrochemicals, or other process industries preferred
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical engineering discipline preferred; Chemical Engineering is desirable, although other relevant engineering disciplines will be considered
* Preferred experience in running or contributing to operational transformation programs, performance improvement initiatives, digital transformation programs, or operating model improvement efforts
* Demonstrated ability to lead defined consulting workstreams, customer workshops, or opportunity development activities with senior stakeholder exposure
* Strong written communication and executive-presentation preparation skills, with ability to create clear customer-facing narratives and C-suite-ready materials
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to structure ambiguous business problems, identify customer value levers, and translate analysis into actionable recommendations
* Strong quantitative skills, including business case development, financial modelling, scenario planning, benchmarking, and value analysis
* Ability to work effectively from Pune with META stakeholders across time zones, balancing independent ownership, remote collaboration, and selected customer-facing engagement
* Ability to travel to Middle East selectively for high-value customer workshops, internal alignment sessions, and strategic pursuits as required

**Value proposition of role**

* Opportunity to help shape the AutonomyX CoE in Pune while taking ownership of selected strategic growth opportunities in the META region
* Blend of customer-facing consulting leadership and high-impact strategy, proposal, analysis, and execution ownership
* High visibility to regional business consulting, sales, and leadership teams through direct contribution to priority transformation pursuits
* Exposure to globally leading operating companies in the Middle East that are at the forefront of technology transformation, autonomy, and next-generation industrial operations
* Strong platform to develop expertise in autonomy, digital transformation, industrial operations, and value-based selling
* Role offers a broad problem-solving, business case, and opportunity-leadership remit across multiple industries and customer situations
* Selective travel intensity compared with pure front-office consulting, while retaining meaningful ownership of strategic customer engagements

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.
