title: Consultant - LBA
description:
The Consultant LBA for Wolters Kluwer will be responsible for performing Legal Bill Analysis (LBA) in the Legal Bill Analysis Center of Excellence (“LBACOE”).
  
  
The Consultant LBA will be responsible for the prompt, accurate and efficient auditing of electronically submitted legal fee and expense invoices submitted by law firms and vendors of our clients. The candidate will be responsible for making adjustments to invoice line-item entries, where those line item entries violate provisions of the relevant billing guidelines, and documenting the justification for such adjustments.
  
  
The Consultant LBA will provide guidance to business unit partners regarding issues or opportunities within the LBA process.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Efficiently and accurately review legal invoice entries.
* Receive legal bill assignments from the Operations Support Specialist and/or work the intake queue for self-assignments.
* Verify compliance with legal billing guidelines by law firms and vendors submitting invoices.
* Verify the accuracy of the UTBMS task codes (Fee, Activity and Expense codes) applied to invoice line items.
* Document reasons for any adjustments made to invoice line items, identifying the billing guideline violated and the rationale for the amount adjusted.
* Forward the audited legal bill through the review chain as required.
* Communicate and calibrate with Legal Invoice Analyst and Quality Assurance Analyst team members. Provide feedback to management on additional calibration opportunities.
* Demonstrated superior ability to review, analyze and evaluate legal fee and cost/expense invoice entries and to exercise discretion and sound judgment when making audit and adjustment decisions.
* Advanced understanding of legal terminology and claims legal situations required.
* When directed by management, support QA Analysts in addressing requests for reconsideration of adjusted amounts submitted by law firms.
* When directed by management, support QA Analysts in conducting the quality assurance review of invoices audited by Legal Invoice Analyst I & II peers, while utilizing SME knowledge in specialized legal practice areas.
* Conduct periodic audit and data analysis to support management in collecting performance metrics for internal use and use with clients and law firms.
* Analyze and condense clients’ legal service agreements to produce effective operational tools, meeting and in some cases exceeding customer expectations.
* When directed by management, assist with the creation and updating of various team and department wide standard operating procedures.
* Participate in the training and mentoring of new Legal Invoice Analysts via informal and formal mentorship and training initiatives, both for new client roll outs and for back-filling vacancies on existing client teams.
* Liaise with and provide periodic feedback to CIOX Artificial Intelligence Decision Science team on functionality and improvement of machine learning end-user experience and accuracy.
* Self-motivated with an ability to work independently and with very limited supervision after training.
* Excellent computer skills with the ability to learn the electronic legal bill submission and auditing software.
* Sound command of the English language-- grammar, syntax and style -- including an understanding of the conventions of punctuation and capitalization.
* Excellent spelling and proofreading skills.
* Effective communication skills - ability to obtain information from others and deliver information to others orally and in written form.
* Organizational skills, including the ability to organize work in an orderly fashion conducive to the prompt, efficient review of an appropriate number of legal invoices in a given day or time period.
* Familiarity with common business math and possess appropriate business telephone skills.
* Ability to carry out detailed written or verbal instructions; ability to respond to requests effectively and efficiently.

**Job Qualifications**
**Education**
Minimum: Paralegal Certification or equivalent work experience. Bachelor’s Degree in legal related discipline and/or equivalent work experience either in-house or with a third-party legal invoice auditing company strongly preferred. Advanced degree a plus.
  
  
Experience, Knowledge and Tools
  
  
Minimum Experience: 3 - 5 years of experience in a legal services or legal bill auditing environment, including:
  
  

* Extensive experience with legal billing processes.
* Firm understanding of the federal and/or state rules of civil procedure.
* Prior legal bill review experience required.
* Experience with one or more practice areas in a legal billing or legal services setting, including but not limited to; insurance, civil litigation, intellectual property, corporate, and banking.

**Required Competencies:**

* Communications: Strong arbitration and organizational skills are critical to being successful in this role. Strong communications skills and the ability to organize and motivate team members in a matrix environment are essential.
* Team Work: Must work collaboratively with people within FCOE and throughout the entire WK organization, while providing constructive feedback to LBACOE leadership.
* Problem Solving: Capable of independent thinking and rendering sound decisions. Astute at identifying and engaging the necessary resources to help in decision making. Takes quick actions to identify and resolve the cause of any problem. Proactive in nature.
* Leadership: Exhibits individual control over day to day responsibilities as well as the ability to work collaboratively with other BUs to produce results.
* Planning and Organizing: Must be able to implement plans with the purpose of achieving short and long term goals. Must be able to prioritize in order to accomplish these goals in a given time period.
* Technology: Has the ability to partner with experts in the technology field to identify technology gaps and requirements necessary to develop position and impactful solutions.
* Learning: Ability to acquire new or modify existing knowledge to support a changing market place and workforce. Can demonstrate a capability to learn by study, experience, or instruction.
* Initiative and Enterprise: Is self-directed and has the ability to translate ideas into action and get things done.
* Critical Thinking: Able to firmly understand the nuances of language and think critically about the meaning behind cryptic language and legal jargon.

**Tools:**

* Microsoft Office Suite ( Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

title: Supply Chain Lead - MEC & Reporting
description:

Full time

Pune, India

Full time

The Supply Chain Lead – MEC will drive financial planning, performance management, and strategic insights for Supply Chain costs across Materials, Manufacturing, Logistics, Overheads, and Business Waste.

**Data Preparation**
:
**COGS Planning & Performance Management**

* Own end-to-end planning, forecasting, and tracking of COGS across cost buckets (Materials, Factory, Logistics, Overheads, Waste)
* Lead variance analysis (Actuals vs Forecast vs Plan) and provide clear insights on cost drivers
* Deliver transparency on supply chain cost performance to senior stakeholders

**Team Management & Leadership (Added)**

* Lead, manage, and develop a team of analysts / finance professionals supporting COGS
* Allocate work, set priorities, and ensure timely and high-quality delivery
* Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration
* Act as escalation point for stakeholders and ensure effective issue resolution
* Build team capability in S4H, analytics, and supply chain finance

* Act as a strategic finance partner to Cost Bucket Owners across Europe and global teams
* Collaborate with Procurement, Manufacturing, and Logistics teams to drive cost efficiency and margin improvement
* Serve as the key interface between Finance, Transfer Pricing teams, and operational stakeholder

**Transfer Pricing & Governance**

* Oversee transfer pricing processes including Business Plan and quarterly TP updates
* Ensure accuracy and governance of intercompany flows and TP corrections
* Identify root causes of discrepancies and strengthen financial controls in collaboration with stakeholders

* Lead development of dashboards and reporting (Power BI, Power Query) for COGS and TP performance
* Provide forward-looking insights, scenario planning, and “what-if” analysis to support decision-making
* Standardize and enhance reporting frameworks across regions

**Transformation & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead transition and knowledge transfer activities (e.g., S4H, TSA milestones)
* Drive automation, process improvements, and digital initiatives in supply chain finance
* Lead projects to enhance analytical capabilities and reporting efficiency

Focuses on period-end closing activities, including accruals, allocations, and tracking special tolling fee arrangements etc.
  
  
**We're Looking For Someone Who**

* 8–12+ years of experience in FP&A / Supply Chain Finance / Operations Finance
* Strong expertise in COGS components (materials, manufacturing, logistics, overheads)
* Proven experience in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modelling
* Exposure to Transfer Pricing and intercompany processes is preferred
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with S4H and Power BI/Power Query
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in a global environment
* Prior experience in team handling / people management preferred
* Experience in FMCG / Manufacturing / Global Business Services (GBS) environment, transformation projects or finance transitions.
* Ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business insights
* Strong problem-solving mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and automation
* Strategic thinking with the ability to translate business goals into operational execution, underpinned by digital technology deployments.
* Data-driven mindset, leveraging analytics to measure, predict and improve performance.
* Good management skills; able to effectively deal with resistance and conflicts, establish strong relationships with partners, and trust.
* Analytical and customer-focused professional with strong attention to detail, a hands-on approach, and ability to perform under pressure, driven by continuous improvement and digital awareness

**What You'll Get**
Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes
  
  

* Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards
* Flexible ways of working
* Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
* Time off to rest and recharge
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* Specific benefits vary by location

**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Senior Specialist, Risk Modeling
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Specialist, Risk Modeling role sits within BNY’s largest modeling organization. The successful candidate will join the Economic Capital Modeling team, supporting ICAAP/ICARA processes and providing end-to-end support for models that inform key management decisions and are regularly reported to Senior Management and the Board of Directors.
  
  
This role is expected to be performed in adherence with corporate-wide standards for model development and industry best practices. The incumbent will be responsible for identifying problems that can be addressed through the application of financial theory and quantitative methods, including evaluating and selecting appropriate modeling frameworks and determining the scope of solutions. The candidate is also expected to use AI responsibly and thoughtfully in support of their work.
  
  
**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways**

* Develop and implement modeling solutions in line with technical direction, ensuring the accuracy and soundness of quantitative methods within the assigned area.
* Conduct independent research and data analysis to address stakeholder inquiries and support decision-making.
* Support senior modelers in both business-as-usual activities and longer-term strategic projects.
* Apply advanced AI tools to streamline, enhance, and automate processes where appropriate.
* Engage directly with stakeholders to understand needs, communicate findings, and provide modeling support.

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following**

* Master’s degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline such as engineering, mathematics, physics, statistics, or economics.
* Strong theoretical foundation combined with solid programming, documentation, and communication skills.
* At least 1 year of modeling-related experience, preferably in financial services.
* Experience with stochastic processes, numerical analysis, and computational methods using programming languages, preferably Python, as well as mathematical and statistical software packages.
* Familiarity with AI frameworks and a strong commitment to responsible AI use.
* Strong attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and a highly focused, analytical mindset.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Finance Transformation (FT) - Finance Operations Transformation**
Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance.
  
  
**Finance Operations Transformation Senior Consultant**
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will help clients reimagine and optimize their finance processes to enable transformation, business growth and digital finance capabilities. This role involves designing future-state operating models, advising on ERP and technology solutions, and leading process improvements across core finance areas. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation on the Finance Transformation - Finance Operations Transformation team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Assessing, designing, and optimizing end-to-end finance processes across Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Record to Report, and Financial Planning and Analysis
* Advising on ERP and digital finance solutions by aligning business requirements with standard and custom technology capabilities
* Redesigning finance processes, data structures, and performance measures, including chart of accounts, cost centers, profit centers, and key performance indicators
* Leading business requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, solution blueprinting, and future-state process design
* Collaborating with cross-functional and global stakeholders to deliver finance transformation programs on time and with measurable business impact

**The team**
Our Finance Transformation – Global Business Services (GBS) practice serves as a trusted advisor to CFOs and executives, helping shape the CFO agenda, improve operating models, and drive enterprise value in the digital economy. The GBS Advisory team partners with organizations to design and implement GBS strategies, including service delivery models, operating model transformation, and location strategies. Leveraging next-generation technologies like Generative AI, we drive innovation across Finance, Procurement, and IT. Our scope includes outsourcing advisory, vendor selection, and end-to-end transformation. We seek motivated individuals with strong analytical, communication, and consulting skills to join our dynamic GBS group
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Pune (Candidates from other locations should be willing to relocate)
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree and Master of Business Administration, or Chartered Accountant qualification
* 3-6 years of finance transformation experience; for Chartered Accountant candidates, 3-6 years of experience after qualification
* Experience in finance process assessment, process reengineering, business requirements gathering, and solution design
* Experience with one or more finance process areas, including Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Record to Report, Financial Planning and Analysis, Tax, Treasury, or Risk and Compliance
* Experience advising on finance data and control structures, including chart of accounts, general ledger, accounting, controlling, costing, planning, consolidation, reporting, data management, or finance analytics
* Experience with ERP or finance technology platforms and alignment of business requirements to system functionality
* Experience creating design documentation, conducting gap analysis, and supporting transformation value realization

**Preferred:**

* Experience supporting or managing large-scale technology implementation programs
* Experience with one or more platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics, BlackLine, HighRadius, Basware, ServiceNow for Finance, Workiva, or Anaplan
* Experience with process mining or process mapping tools such as Celonis or Epiplex
* Experience in Finance Operations, Financial Planning and Analysis, Enterprise Performance Management, or industry-specific finance processes
* Experience with digital finance technologies such as robotic process automation, Generative AI, predictive analytics, or machine learning
* Experience working with global stakeholders or teams outside India, preferably in the United States

description:
**Who we are**

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. **Job summary**

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst – GTM FP&A to join our Finance organization. This role will report directly to the VP of FP&A and will play a key role in supporting the company’s GTM planning, reporting, forecasting, and financial modeling.

The ideal candidate has strong financial modeling and analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex SaaS performance data into clear and concise reporting for senior leadership.

This role will have significant exposure to ARR, bookings, revenue, billings, churn, renewals, expansions, contractions, and retention metrics, with a particular focus on building and maintaining reporting models and executive-level reporting decks.

The position will be based in India and will work closely with Finance leadership in both India and the U.S. The role will also have a dotted-line relationship with the Director of Finance – India.

Improvements, data hygiene & system automation.

**About Cencora & Abfinco**
Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen) is a Fortune 10 global pharmaceutical distribution and solutions company operating in more than 65 countries. ABFinco is Cencora’s international in-house bank, providing central cash pooling, foreign exchange and intercompany funding services to international businesses including Alliance Healthcare, World Courier and PharmaLex. ABFinco manages exposures in more than 10 active currencies.
  
  
**ROLE PURPOSE**
The Senior Treasury Accountant will deliver accurate, timely and well-controlled accounting for ABFinco’s foreign exchange, intercompany lending and cash activities. The role owns treasury accounting from transaction capture in Kyriba through posting and reconciliation in SAP, leads the monthly close, and provides quality review and technical support to Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts. Reporting to the Treasury Accounting Lead, the role will also strengthen controls, reporting and processes as the in-house treasury accounting function develops.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Treasury Accounting and Close**

* Own accounting for FX, hedging, cash and intercompany treasury transactions in Kyriba and SAP.
* Review treasury entries, valuations and interest accruals.
* Lead the monthly close and deliver accurate management accounts and treasury reporting between workday 1 and workday 3.
* Reconcile Kyriba to SAP, resolve differences and maintain complete supporting documentation.
* Support hedge-accounting calculations, statutory reporting, Group consolidation and internal and external audits.

**Intercompany Loans And Cash**

* Oversee accounting and reconciliation for intercompany loans, cash pools and Group funding balances across 102 entities.
* Review loan interest, reference rates and margins against agreements and transfer-pricing requirements.
* Prepare and review loan, cash and bank reconciliation reports.

**Controls and Systems**

* Operate treasury-accounting controls, maintain audit evidence and support control testing.
* Maintain treasury-system master data and support Kyriba-to-SAP interfaces, reporting and process improvements.
* Support regulatory reporting and ensure transactions comply with internal policies and segregation-of-duties requirements.

**Team and Stakeholder Support**

* Act as the subject matter expert and escalation point for Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts.
* Work with Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, IT, banking partners and international finance teams to resolve issues and support change.

**Essential**
**PROFILE & SKILLS**

* Chartered Accountant, Cost and Management Accountant, ACCA or equivalent finance qualification, with 4–7 years of relevant treasury accounting experience.
* Practical experience of month-end close, reconciliations, FX accounting and intercompany accounting.
* Hands-on experience with an ERP or treasury management system; SAP or Kyriba exposure is preferred.

Strong analytical, reconciliation and control skills, with attention to detail in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.
  
  

* Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills across Treasury, Finance, Tax, Legal and IT.
* Ability to review work, coach colleagues and manage priorities in a Shared Service Centre environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a multinational treasury, in-house bank or treasury shared-services environment.
* Knowledge of cash pooling, intercompany funding and hedge accounting under IFRS 9 or ASC 815.
* Exposure to Kyriba, SAP, Bloomberg, or trade-confirmation platforms.
* Treasury qualification or relevant professional development is desirable.

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of experience in accounting, financial operations, reconciliations, close support, reporting support, or a related field required. Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), or equivalent certification preferred. Knowledge of accounting principles, including cost accounting and financial statement analysis. Working knowledge of accounting software and ERP systems; SAP experience is preferred. Ability to create clear, user-tailored financial reports. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. Strong mathematical, analytical, and fact-based analysis skills with attention to detail. Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Ability to work independently and handle stressful situations.

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Management Accounting (COE) team as part of our risk, reinsurance, and capital business at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune . This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**Senior Specialist – Finance and Accounting (Grade C2)**
This role supports annual statutory reporting and local compliance for multiple entities, including preparing statutory accounts, tax returns, and regulatory filings within deadlines. It involves coordinating with local controllers, statutory accounting teams, and auditors to complete templates, notes to accounts, and final signed reports. The role also ensures tracker discipline, documentation updates, and continuous process improvement across regions.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Preparation and review of Annual Statutory accounts for entities as part of COE
* Time bound submissions of annual statutory accounts per the regulatory timelines
* Engaging with local controllers and statutory accounting team for creation of templates in Statutory reporting tool (Caseware / Workiva) and Notes to accounts before the due date of filing
* Audit support until signing of final statutory report
* Preparation of tax returns and other local compliances
* Adherence to operation tracker set for the team and ensure completeness with accuracy
* Providing assistance in filing of timely regulatory returns
* Adoption of best practices across regions and suggesting improvements to the process
* Preparation and maintaining the DPM.s (Process notes) upto date in the format adopted by AO
* Supporting team / process/ organization initiatives

**What you need to have:**

* Qualified CA with 2-3 years of experience in statutory accounting, taxation and finalization of accounts
* Strong commerce graduate with 6+ years of accounting experience in statutory accounting, taxation and finalization of accounts
* Sound knowledge of accounting principles and practices
* Prior experience in working in similar roles

**What makes you stand out:**

* Diploma in IFRS
* Prior working experience in Insurance Sector

**Why join our team:**

* We help you do your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work, and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can collaborate with talented colleagues to create innovative solutions and have impact on colleagues, clients, and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Treasury Senior Expert APAC (f/m/x)
description:
**Make individual mobility more enjoyable and sustainable by advancing technology and people**
– As one of the top 100 automotive suppliers worldwide, Webasto actively shapes the transformation of the industry through expertise and forward-thinking solutions. Our goal is to make mobility a full sensory experience, working toward more comfort, wind in your hair, the perfect temperature in any season, and driving with a clear conscience – for a safe and sustainable future. We bring joy to mobility – are you in?

**You can look forward to these exciting tasks:**

* Identify, quantify and monitor transactional and translational FX and interest rate exposures across APAC business units and countries, ensuring transparent and reliable risk reporting.
* Develop and execute hedging strategies in line with internal Corporate Treasury policies, market conditions and applicable regulatory and accounting requirements, including IFRS 9, IFRS 18 and EMIR where relevant.
* Integrate FX impacts and settlement effects into regional and group-wide cash flow planning to support proactive hedging, funding and liquidity decisions.
* Support and further drive the automation of settlement payments, valuation and accounting processes related to derivative and FX transactions.
* Monitor and actively support the reduction of local and trapped cash positions, including foreign currency balances, throughout APAC.
* Manage relationships with local banks and FX counterparties, including best-execution oversight, settlement instructions and coordination of bank accounts and electronic banking setups such as EBICS, H2H and SWIFT.
* Support daily Treasury operations and governance topics, including foreign currency disposition, KYC coordination and group-wide guarantee business, ensuring adherence to Treasury processes and guidelines.
* Contribute to the design, standardization and continuous improvement of APAC Treasury Hub processes, controls, reporting and service delivery.

**This is what you bring to us**

* Five to eight years of experience in Corporate Treasury, ideally in a multinational or industrial automotive environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics or a related discipline; a relevant master’s degree is an advantage.
* Demonstrated expertise in FX markets, instruments and hedging strategies.
* Experience with Treasury Management Systems and market-data tools, for example Coupa, SAP, 360T, Thomson Reuters, S&P or comparable applications, plus advanced Excel modelling skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with high attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across countries, entities and functions.
* Fluent in English, German is beneficial. Additional APAC languages are an advantage.

title: Founder's Office Associate
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a sharp, multi-disciplinary Graduate Associate to work directly with the Founder. In the MEP industry, projects move fast and require a mix of technical precision and commercial savvy. You will act as the "right hand" to the leadership, helping transition the firm from engineering concepts to market-leading execution. This role is perfect for a fresh graduate who wants to see the "business side" of engineering early in their career.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Market Research & MEP Trends: Research emerging technologies like BIM (Building Information Modeling), sustainable HVAC solutions, and IoT-integrated electrical systems to keep the firm competitive.
* Business Development & Tendering: Assist in preparing technical bids and commercial proposals. You will help identify new "Greenfield" and "Brownfield" project opportunities in the commercial and industrial sectors.
* Financial & Project Modeling: Support the founder in project cost estimation, resource allocation modeling, and tracking the profitability of ongoing MEP contracts.
* Graphic Design & Branding: Take ownership of the firm’s visual identity. You will design brand decks, technical brochures, and high-impact project portfolios for client meetings.
* Data Analytics: Analyze project timelines and labor costs to identify bottlenecks, providing the founder with data-driven reports to improve operational efficiency.

**The Profile we are looking for**

* Educational Background: A recent degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (preferred) or Business/Architecture with a strong interest in the built environment.
* The "Swiss Army Knife" Mindset: You are equally comfortable reading a technical floor plan as you are designing a logo or building a spreadsheet.
* Software Savvy:
* Engineering: Awareness of AutoCAD or Revit (BIM) is a plus.
* Design: Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Illustrator or Figma.
* Data: Advanced Excel skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, basic macros).
* Tech: Proficient in using AI technology to generate results.
* Communication: Exceptional writing skills to draft "Nearby Engineers" style documentation and professional correspondence.

**What is in it for you?**

* Direct Mentorship: Work daily with the Founder, gaining insights that usually take 10 years to acquire.
* Holistic Growth: Develop a rare profile that combines engineering logic with business development and creative design.
* Impact: Your research and designs will be the face of the firm in front of developers and architects.

This is a dynamic role, beyond the listed responsibilities, you will be expected to step in and own any high-priority tasks as needed.

title: Procurement Risk Analyst
description:
The Procurement Risk Analyst supports procurement and supply chain operations by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating supplier and supply chain risks to ensure business continuity and operational efficiency. This role executes procurement strategies aligned with material buying plans, with a focus on improving supplier performance, capacity readiness, and risk mitigation ahead of demand. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, supplier risk management expertise, data visualization skills, and stakeholder collaboration to provide actionable insights that support procurement decision-making and supply continuity. The analyst will also act as a data steward, ensuring data quality, governance, and consistency across procurement systems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyze supplier and supply chain data to identify risks, vulnerabilities, and potential business impacts, and provide actionable insights to procurement and business leaders.
* Coordinate with sourcing managers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to assess risks and develop mitigation and business continuity plans.
* Support supplier performance improvement initiatives while maintaining high-quality product and service delivery.
* Monitor supplier capacity, continuity of supply, reputational risks, and margin-related risks, and proactively implement risk mitigation strategies.
* Prepare and present recommendations for process improvements, risk reduction opportunities, and alternative courses of action to procurement leadership.
* Support procurement operations related to supplier onboarding, qualification, contract management, payment issues, and order fulfillment.
* Serve as the communication conduit between suppliers, sourcing teams, and manufacturing facilities during supplier issues or disruptions.
* Provide delivery and expediting support to plants/sites during supplier constraints or operational challenges.
* Support management and execution of engineering releases impacting suppliers.
* Collect, validate, and maintain supplier scorecard data and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Act as a Data Steward by ensuring data integrity, governance, quality, and consistency across procurement systems.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and automations using tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Excel, and database systems to improve efficiency and visibility.
* Proactively monitor procurement systems, identify issues, and drive corrective actions to ensure uninterrupted operations.
* Document and share best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives across procurement teams.
* Drive process automation and system enhancements to improve productivity and reduce manual effort.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Supply Base Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate supplier risks related to supply continuity, reputation, and profitability.
* Data Analytics & Visualization: Strong capability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data, identify trends, and present actionable insights using dashboards and reporting tools.
* Procurement Systems Knowledge: Proficiency in ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, and related purchasing, quality, and payment systems.
* Advanced Technical Skills: Expertise in Advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, Macros), Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, and reporting automation.
* Supplier Performance Management: Ability to monitor supplier KPIs, manage corrective actions, and drive continuous supplier improvement.
* Supplier Capacity Management: Understanding of supplier capacity planning, forecasting, and demand alignment.
* Contract Management: Ability to assess contractual terms, monitor supplier compliance, and manage contract lifecycle activities.
* Problem Solving: Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving using data-driven methodologies.
* Negotiation Excellence: Ability to support negotiations to achieve mutually beneficial business outcomes.
* Stakeholder Management: Strong collaboration and relationship-building with suppliers, sourcing teams, manufacturing, and internal stakeholders.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and present insights effectively.
* Escalation & Conflict Management: Ability to manage escalations calmly and resolve issues with minimal business disruption.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, implement process improvements, and adapt to changing business needs.
* Agility & Decision Making: Quick decision-making capability with strong business judgment in dynamic environments.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5–6 years of experience in procurement, supply chain analytics, supplier management, or source-to-pay operations.
* Hands-on experience in procurement data analysis, business intelligence, and visualization tools.
* Experience in supplier risk management and business continuity planning.
* Exposure to end-to-end Source-to-Pay processes including supplier qualification, onboarding, contract management, and payment cycles.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in global or matrix organizations.
* Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments preferred.

**Additional Information**

* Work Location: Cummins India Technical Center (IOC), Pune, India
* Shift Timing: Afternoon / EMEA Shift (12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST)
* Work Mode: Hybrid / On-site with flexibility

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, or a related field.
* Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred, with specialization in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations.
* Additional certifications in Risk Management, Procurement, Project Management (PMP/Prince2), or Data Analytics are an advantage.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Senior Financial Analyst**
**Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India**
**JOB OVERVIEW**
Legion is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to help drive disciplined planning, forecasting and decision support across a growing SaaS business. This role will own assigned forecasts and reporting, build scalable financial models, analyze financial and operating performance, and translate findings into clear recommendations for leaders.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong FP&A fundamentals with commercial judgment, comfort working with SaaS metrics and systems, and the ability to partner effectively with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assist Financial Planning and Analysis Director in managing the strategic planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
* Own designated components of the annual budget, periodic forecasts and long-range plan, including assumptions, scenario analysis and consolidation support.
* Develop and maintain driver-based financial models for revenue, headcount, operating expenses, pricing, investments and strategic initiatives
* Deep understanding of SaaS financial and operational KPIs, a strong ability to analyze data to identify trends, actual performance against budget, forecast, prior periods risks, opportunities for growth. Monitor key KPIs and recommend corrective actions.
* Prepare accurate monthly and quarterly management reporting, dashboards, executive presentations and decision-support materials.
* Investigate revenue, cost, margin, and operational variances and explain key business drivers.
* Partner with business functions to evaluate performance and support commercial decisions.
* Perform profitability, pricing, cost-benefit, ROI, sensitivity and ad hoc analyses to support business cases and investment decisions.
* Support month-end and quarter-end closing activities in coordination with accounting teams by reviewing results, validating data and resolving reporting discrepancies.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, integrity of financial data and reports through standardization, automation and effective use of finance systems.
* Maintain appropriate financial controls, documentation and data integrity, and support audit or compliance requests related to assigned work.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA is required or relevant professional qualification is preferred
* 5+ years of experience in in FP&A, strategic finance, business finance or a closely related analytical finance role in a SaaS, enterprise-software company
* Proficiency with NetSuite required;
* Advanced financial modelling skills, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and management accounting , financial statement and operation analysis.
* Ability to synthesize complex financial and operational data into concise insights and practical recommendations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a results-driven mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions.
* Demonstrated commitment to confidentiality, integrity, and professional ethics.
* Experience with BI or data tools such as Tableau, Power BI or SQL, and an interest in using automation or AI to improve finance workflows

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Accuracy and timeliness of budgets, forecasts, and management reports.
* Quality and relevance of financial insights and recommendations.
* Forecast accuracy and variance management.
* Achievement of cost-optimization and profitability-improvement targets.
* Timely completion of financial analyses and strategic projects.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and effectiveness of finance business partnering.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
  
  
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch on Legion

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

title: Senior Financial Planner & Analyst
description:
FP&A / Business Finance
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a finance professional who can own planning, forecasting, management reporting, business analysis, working capital, and financial modelling in a high-growth environment.
  
  
We hire on
**demonstrated capability, not on credentials**
. The role requires strong financial ownership, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Planning & Forecasting
* Own the annual operating plan, a rolling 12-month forecast, and driver-based models and business plans built on volumes, pricing, bill-of-material cost and headcount, not last year plus a percentage.
* Management Reporting & MIS
* Own the monthly pack for both entities and the consolidation, covering P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, KPIs and cost centres.
* Prepare sales and cost performance reporting, delivered to a fixed working day.
* Dashboards & Business Reporting
* Build and maintain CEO, CFO, functional-head and investor dashboards.
* Ensure one definition per metric, with controls that prove the numbers tie.
* Cash, Working Capital & Treasury
* Own the cash position statement and short-term cash forecast.
* Track receivables and payables ageing and collections, inventory ageing, DSO / DIO / DPO.
* Manage treasury and investment valuation summaries, along with the overall liquidity and runway view.
* Variance Analysis
* Perform budget vs actual, forecast vs actual, month-on-month and year-on-year analysis.
* Decompose variances into volume, rate and mix.
* Provide the cause, impact and recommended action — not just the number.
* Unit Economics & Pricing
* Analyse profitability by product, segment, customer and geography.
* Build cost structures from bill of material to commissioning.
* Provide deal-level margin support.
* Develop capital-expenditure and make-versus-buy business cases.
* Board, Investor & Fundraising Support
* Support the financial sections of the board pack and investor MIS.
* Build the models, scenarios and diligence data required for a fundraise.
* Market & Competitive Insight
* Conduct market sizing and demand analysis.
* Track competitors and perform benchmarking that informs business planning and pricing decisions.
* Working Capital Improvement
* Drive working capital as an agenda, not just a report.
* Own a tracked improvement programme with named owners across sales, supply chain and procurement.
* Automation & Process Improvement
* Move the reporting cycle from assembly to analysis.
* Use Power Query, a single mapped data layer, and clear documentation so that the reporting process can be independently run by anyone on the team the following month.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
We hire on
**demonstrated capability, not on credentials**
. A
**CA, CMA, MBA (Finance) or CFA**
would be relevant.
  
  
**Core Experience & Capabilities**

* 5 years in FP&A, business finance, management reporting or corporate finance, including an audit or advisory background with a deliberate move into analysis.
* Personally owned a monthly reporting pack for at least twelve consecutive cycles.
* Built a budget or forecast from drivers, not from last year plus a percentage.
* Written variance commentary that senior management acted on.
* Worked directly from a trial balance or an ERP extract, not only from clean data handed over to you.
* Strong advanced Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Power Query, Power BI or SQL is a strong plus.
* Have the instinct to say “this does not tie” before a pack goes out — and hold that line.

Good to Have
  
  

* Recurring ownership of receivables, payables and cash reporting.
* Experience in treasury or investment reporting.
* Multi-entity consolidation and multi-currency experience.
* Experience in manufacturing, hardware or supply-chain-intensive industries.
* Experience with market sizing or competitive benchmarking for a management audience.

title: Associate Manager - Client Reporting
description:
****Responsibilities****
**What Makes This Opportunity Unique**
At Principal Financial Group, we pride ourselves on delivering world-class financial solutions and services. As an Assistant Manager - Client Reporting, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring flawless execution of client reporting and portfolio performance analysis. You will lead a motivated team, direct operations, and have the opportunity to collaborate with top-tier professionals both within our organization and externally. This is a chance to showcase your proven leadership skills and contribute to our ambitious goals while improving your own career growth!
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Manage daily Client Reporting and Portfolio Performance Reporting to ensure accurate, complete, and timely outputs throughout daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly cycles.
* Direct and mentor a team; set clear objectives, delegate effectively, remove roadblocks, and act as the point of contact for critical issues to ensure timely delivery.
* Partner with Principal Global Investors (PGI) Shared Services, boutique teams, and external collaborators to align requirements, resolve issues, and improve reporting quality.
* Apply strong controls and standard operating procedures to meet regulatory and operational expectations; track metrics and drive continuous improvement.
* Understand front-to-back data flows; work alongside Information Technology (IT) to resolve data issues and stabilize/report through structured huddles and check-ins.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Client and performance reporting activities (35%)
* Plan and coordinate daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly reporting production; ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery according to Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain control evidence, exception logs, and approvals; ensure consistent templates and disclosures.
* People leadership and development (30%)
* Mentor, develop, and motivate team members; provide timely feedback and objective performance evaluations.
* Define roles, delegate work with measurable objectives, manage coverage, and hold the team accountable for outcomes.
* Collaborator partnership and communication (15%)
* Build positive relationships with head office and boutique collaborators; communicate status, risks, and decisions transparently.
* Manage conflicts constructively; ensure clear handoffs with Shared Services and external partners.
* Process improvement, metrics, and planning (10%)
* Contribute to planning and operating model improvements; identify low-value work and streamline workflows.
* Use metrics, huddles, and check-ins to monitor efficiency, quality, and capacity; recommend resource adjustments.
* Risk, compliance, and decision-making (5%)
* Apply operational and regulatory procedures; perform root cause analysis for issues and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Advance material risks promptly with recommended options.
* Data flow and systems collaboration (5%)
* Chart front-to-back data flows; collaborate with IT and business data owners to address breaks and implement alternative solutions that satisfy reporting goals.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, economics, or business (or equivalent) with 10–12 years of experience in investment, asset management, mutual fund operations, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of investment products and services, performance calculation, securities processing, trade life cycle, and corporate actions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, relationship building, delegation, and presentation skills; diligent and adaptable in changing (VUCA) environments.
* Able to prioritize, make sound decisions, and deliver consistent results under deadlines; open to feedback and continuous improvement.
* Tools/Tech: Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word; collaboration tools (e.g., Microsoft Teams); data visualization (Power BI); performance/reporting platforms (Eagle, Factset); workflow/ticketing tools (JIRA); document repositories (e.g., SharePoint or TBD).

****Skills That Help You To Stand Out:****

* Demonstrated leadership in client and performance reporting operations with quantifiable SLA achievement and quality results.
* Expertise in mentoring teams, setting measurable objectives, and using data-focused huddles/check-ins to manage efficiency and quality.
* Ability to identify data issues throughout front-to-back flows and collaborate with IT to apply lasting solutions.
* Track record in simplifying processes, eliminating low-value work, and scaling standard templates and controls across boutiques/Shared Services.
* Strong approach to handling blocking issues with clear problem statements, root causes, and recommended options.

**Shift Timings: 1.30PM to 10.30PM**

title: Senior Associates – Balance Sheet and Control CoE
description:
**Job Description**

The Senior Accounting Control Associate is responsible for driving the organization's financial governance and control framework through the execution, oversight and continuous enhancement of key accounting controls. This role provides advanced support across balance sheet reconciliations, ASC 606 revenue recognition compliance, journal entry governance, SOX controls, audit readiness, and financial close processes.

The role requires strong analytical capabilities, the ability to independently manage complex accounting control activities, identify and mitigate financial risks and partner with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen the overall control environment. The Senior Associate is also expected to lead process improvement initiatives, mentor junior team members and support management in ensuring compliance with accounting standards, internal policies and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Balance Sheet Reconciliations & Account Governance

* Lead the preparation and review of complex balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely completion.

* Perform detailed analysis of high-risk and critical accounts, identifying trends, anomalies, and potential control concerns.

* Drive resolution of aged reconciling items and collaborate with business stakeholders to remediate issues.

* Monitor compliance with reconciliation policies, governance standards, and control requirements.

* Support management reviews and provide insights on account integrity and financial risk exposure.

* Coach and guide team members on reconciliation best practices and quality standards.

2. Revenue Recognition Controls (ASC 606)

* Execute and oversee revenue recognition control activities in compliance with ASC 606 and company policies.

* Review complex revenue transactions and supporting documentation to ensure accurate accounting treatment.

* Assess and investigate revenue-related risks, exceptions and control gaps, driving timely remediation.

* Partner with Revenue Assurance, Finance, Commercial, and Controllership teams to ensure compliance and operational effectiveness.

* Support implementation of new revenue recognition requirements, process changes, and control enhancements.

* Provide subject matter expertise on revenue control matters and assist with issue resolution.

3. Journal Entry Governance & Financial Close

* Review and approve journal entries for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting policies.

* Coordinate and support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities to ensure timely reporting.

* Monitor close performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.

* Ensure appropriate documentation, review evidence and control execution are maintained throughout the close cycle.

* Support resolution of complex accounting issues impacting financial reporting and close processes.

* Assist management in driving a robust financial close governance framework.

4. SOX Compliance, IPE & Audit Management

* Execute and oversee SOX controls and Information Produced by the Entity (IPE) validation procedures.

* Maintain audit-ready documentation and ensure control evidence meets internal and external audit requirements.

* Coordinate responses to audit requests and support walkthroughs, testing and remediation activities.

* Identify control deficiencies, recommend corrective actions and track remediation to closure.

* Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Compliance and Controllership teams to strengthen governance practices.

* Contribute to risk assessments and the continuous enhancement of the control environment.

5. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement

* Develop and enhance control dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting to support governance oversight.

* Perform trend analysis and identify emerging risks, control exceptions and improvement opportunities.

* Lead automation and process optimization initiatives utilizing technology and reporting tools.

* Drive standardization of processes, documentation and control execution across operating units.

* Support implementation of best practices related to controllership, compliance and financial governance.

* Recommend and implement improvements that enhance efficiency, control effectiveness, and reporting quality.

6. Leadership & Stakeholder Management

* Serve as a key point of contact for finance, controllership, audit, and business stakeholders.

* Provide guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing to junior associates and new team members.

* Lead small projects and improvement initiatives with minimal supervision.

* Support managers in strategic controllership and governance programs.

* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.

* 5-8 years of experience in accounting, controllership, financial controls, audit, SOX compliance, or financial governance functions.

* Strong knowledge of US GAAP, ASC 606 revenue recognition requirements and SOX compliance frameworks.

* Proven experience supporting month-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, and financial reporting processes.

* Experience working with internal and external auditors in a regulated environment.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk assessment capabilities.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, influence outcomes, and deliver under tight deadlines.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience

* Experience working in a multinational, publicly traded, or SOX-regulated organization.

* Advanced experience with:

* OneStream (Account Reconciliations and Controls)

* SAP (General Ledger, Journal Entries, Financial Reporting)

* Advanced Microsoft Excel & Power BI, Alteryx, or similar reporting and automation tools

* Strong understanding of internal control frameworks, risk management, and governance practices.

* Knowledge of emerging technologies and automation solutions in finance and controllership functions.

**Additional Information**

Internal Note: The role is at P5

Job Location: Pune

Mode : Hybrid

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off

title: Credit Strategy & Decisioning Consultant
description:
Credit Strategy & Decisioning Consultant

Location: India

Company: Blue Polaris Inc.

Engagement Type: Consulting / Contractor

Experience Level: Senior

Language Required: English (professional level required)

ABOUT BLUE POLARIS

At Blue Polaris, we are redefining how businesses make decisions. As a global leader in decision automation, AI, and business architecture, we partner with Fortune 500 companies to design intelligent, transparent systems using Decision Model and Notation (DMN) and our proprietary Decisions First™ approach.

We don't just solve problems — we model how organizations think, decide, and act. By combining AI, analytics, business architecture, and human expertise, we help enterprises improve outcomes at scale.

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are looking for a Credit Strategy & Decisioning Consultant — a senior banking practitioner who has personally defined how lending decisions get made. Not someone who built the system that executes the decisions, and not someone who used data science to analyse them. We need the expert who sat at the table where credit strategy was designed: who determined the credit box, defined account management strategy, set the rules for approvals, declines, and counter-offers, and owned the logic that governed how a lender treated its customers across the credit lifecycle.

Your mission at Blue Polaris is to transfer that expertise into our practice. Working directly with our automation architects, you will help us understand how banks and lenders actually make credit decisions — the policies, the strategies, the segmentation logic, the account management frameworks — so we can model that thinking into intelligent, automated decisioning systems that we take to market.

This is an advisory and knowledge transfer role. You are the domain authority. You define what good credit strategy looks like. Our technology teams build it.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The right person uses language like this naturally:

* "I defined our credit strategy for the personal loan portfolio across acquisition, account management, and collections."
* "I owned the credit box — the eligibility criteria, the risk appetite, the cutoff logic across segments."
* "I designed the account management strategy — when to increase limits, when to decrease, how we treated different risk tiers."
* "I set the rules for how we approved, declined, and counter-offered across different customer segments."
* "I determined how we used bureau data and alternate data to make better credit decisions — not by building models, but by defining the strategy those models were built to support."
* "I worked with data science and analytics teams to tell them what we needed to decision — they built it, I defined what it should do."

The wrong person uses language like this:

* "I built scorecards and ML models to improve credit risk prediction."
* "I implemented the business rule engine and configured the decisioning platform."
* "I used machine learning techniques to improve credit risk outcomes."
* "I was the technical lead on the credit decisioning system implementation."

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Credit Strategy Definition & Knowledge Transfer

* Define and document the credit strategies, account management frameworks, and decisioning logic that governed lending portfolios you have owned or managed.
* Articulate how credit boxes, risk appetite statements, segmentation logic, and underwriting waterfalls were designed and evolved across products and economic cycles.
* Explain the decision logic behind approvals, declines, counteroffers, limit management, pricing, and adverse action — in structured, transferable frameworks that Blue Polaris's automation teams can model and implement.
* Share how you used bureau data, alternate data, and customer behavior signals to inform credit strategy — focusing on the strategic intent, not the technical build.

Account Management & Portfolio Strategy

* Define account management strategies across the credit lifecycle: limit increases and decreases, balance transfer treatments, hardship programs, early intervention triggers, and collections prioritization logic.
* Articulate how portfolio performance analytics — vintage curves, roll rates, EPD, delinquency trends — informed strategic adjustments to credit policy and account management frameworks.
* Share how risk-based pricing strategies were designed and governed, and how pricing decisions were connected to credit risk segmentation.

Go-to-Market & Client Engagement Support

* Contribute to Blue Polaris's capability collateral — helping us demonstrate to banking clients that we deeply understand how credit decisions are made, not just how to automate them.
* Support solution design conversations by acting as the credit strategy voice — explaining what banks actually do and what automation can realistically replace or enhance.
* Review and validate the decisioning frameworks our automation teams build to ensure they accurately reflect real-world credit strategy logic.

REQUIREMENTS

Education:

* Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Master's, MBA, or postgraduate qualification in Finance, Risk Management, or Banking is a strong plus.

Experience — all required:

* 10+ years of experience on the bank or lender side in credit strategy, credit policy, or account management — owning the decisions, not implementing the systems.
* Proven track record of defining credit strategy across one or more retail lending products: credit cards, personal loans, mortgages, auto loans, MSME lending, or BNPL.
* Experience presenting credit strategy recommendations to credit committees, risk committees, or senior leadership and owning the outcome of those decisions.
* Deep understanding of how credit decisions are governed across the full lending lifecycle — from acquisition and underwriting through to account management, collections, and recovery.
* Experience working with data science, analytics, and technology teams to define what credit strategy should do — directing their output, not building it yourself.

Domain Knowledge:

* Credit strategy design: credit box definition, risk appetite, segmentation, underwriting waterfall logic, cutoff management.
* Account management strategy: limit management, balance strategies, hardship treatments, early warning triggers.
* Portfolio analytics interpretation: vintage analysis, roll rates, EPD, loss forecasting — using these to inform strategy, not build the models.
* Regulatory and compliance awareness: understanding how credit decisions must be governed under FCRA, ECOA/Reg B, TILA/Reg Z, UDAAP, or equivalent frameworks.
* Bureau and data strategy: how to use Experian, TransUnion, Equifax, or alternate data providers to sharpen credit decisions — from a strategy perspective.

KEY SKILLS

* Ability to articulate complex credit strategy logic in clear, structured, transferable frameworks — you can explain how you made decisions, not just that you made them.
* Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences — comfortable in a boardroom and in a working session with automation architects.
* Strategic thinking combined with operational depth — you have designed credit strategy and lived with the portfolio consequences of those decisions.
* Collaborative approach to knowledge transfer — you are willing to teach, document, and validate what you know so others can build on it.
* Analytical mindset for interpreting portfolio performance and translating insights into strategic adjustments.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience across multiple lending products or multiple institutions — breadth of credit strategy exposure is valued.
* Familiarity with decision modelling concepts such as DMN (Decision Model and Notation) or exposure to how credit rules are structured in decisioning engines — from a strategy perspective, not a technical build perspective.
* Experience working in or alongside consulting engagements advising banks on credit strategy transformation.
* Certifications: FRM, CFA, CRMP, PRM, or equivalent risk management credentials.

WHY JOIN BLUE POLARIS?

* Innovate: Your credit strategy expertise becomes the foundation for AI-driven decisioning that transforms how banks lend.
* Global Exposure: Collaborate with Fortune 500 clients and world-class teams across the Americas and beyond.
* Grow Fast: Bridge the gap between deep credit domain knowledge and the future of automated, intelligent decisioning.
* Hands-On Impact: Your thinking goes directly into client engagements — not into a document that sits on a shelf.
* Learn from Experts: Work alongside pioneers in DMN, decision automation, and AI-driven business architecture.
* Remote-First: Work from anywhere in India in a flexible, high-growth consulting environment.
* Make a Difference: Help banks across the globe make faster, smarter, and more consistent lending decisions.

Employees within GBS partner with multiple teams in countries across Europe ranging from Factories, Distribution Centers, Supply Chain Planning, Customer Services, Procurement. You will become part of the delivery service engine behind TMICC’s hero brands and will have the opportunity to implement new solutions and processes alongside an innovative tech stack that is been delivered as part of the separation from Unilever program. * Manage finance-related processes within the Legal function, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timeliness.
* Prepare, review, submit, and track expense reports in accordance with internal policies.
* Raise Purchase Orders (POs) and support invoice processing, follow-up, and closure.
* Ensure compliance with internal financial policies, controls, billing processes, and approval requirements. 2. Matter, Invoice & Billing Management
* Create and maintain legal matter records in Legal Tracker or similar matter management / e-billing systems.
* Support invoice review processes, including validation against billing guidelines, approved rates, matter information, and supporting documentation.
* Support review of UTBMS codes, LEDES formats, billing narratives, and invoice data quality.
* Conduct timekeeper rate reviews and support resolution of discrepancies with Legal, Finance, and external law firms. 3. Budgeting, Accruals & Forecasting
* Support preparation of legal budget reports, forecasts, accruals, and spend tracking.
* Maintain forecast trackers and financial data repositories for Legal matters and vendors.
* Gather, validate, and follow up on financial information to ensure completeness, accuracy, and timely reporting.
* Identify trends, variances, and follow-up items related to legal fees, budgets, and spend. 4. Vendor, Law Firm & Stakeholder Coordination
* Collaborate with lawyers, Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, external law firms, and vendors to resolve legal fee, billing, payment, and budget-related issues.
* Support vendor onboarding processes and maintain accurate vendor and law firm records.
* Manage the Legal support mailbox and act as a central point of contact for legal finance queries. 5. Systems, Tools & Process Support
* Support Legal Tracker or similar finance, matter management, and e-billing platforms.
* Troubleshoot platform issues and coordinate resolution with customer support teams, vendors, IT, Finance, and relevant internal teams.
* Support integration and alignment with other Finance tools and enterprise systems.
* Maintain accurate, structured, and up-to-date records, documentation, trackers, and process references. 6. Reporting, Dashboards & Continuous Improvement
* Prepare dashboards, reports, and operational summaries covering legal spend, matters, invoices, vendors, forecasts, accruals, and process performance.
* Support continuous improvement of financial processes within Legal GBS.
* Identify opportunities to improve data quality, transparency, controls, and efficiency across legal finance operations. We're looking for someone who Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field. 7–9 years of experience in a finance-related role, preferably AP / AR / P2P, Legal Operations, e-billing, matter management, or shared services environment. Experience working with financial systems, legal e-billing platforms, matter management systems, or enterprise workflow tools. Experience in a multinational or GBS environment is an advantage. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications including Word and PowerPoint. Experience with Legal Tracker or similar matter management / e-billing systems is preferred. Understanding of legal finance processes including purchase orders, invoices, accruals, forecasting, vendor onboarding, and legal spend tracking. Familiarity with billing guidelines, UTBMS codes, LEDES formats, timekeeper rates, and law firm invoice review processes is preferred. Ability to prepare trackers, dashboards, reports, and structured financial summaries. Comfort working with finance tools, legal technology platforms, and system integration / troubleshooting processes.
