title: Business Finance Manager
description:
**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra (On-site)

**Experience:**

2–6 Years

**# ROLE OVERVIEW:**

You're the person who turns numbers into decisions. A patient pays an advance in USD, a partner hospital in Turkey needs a payout, and the founders ask, “Are we actually making money on this case?” You're the one with the answer.

As Business Finance Manager, you will own budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance across CureMeAbroad. You will partner with sales, operations, and the founding team to plan expenditure, protect margins across our 350+ partner network, and maintain predictable cash flow.

Your core mission is to turn financial data into clear, actionable business plans.

**# KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Budgeting & Forecasting**

Own the annual budgeting cycle and develop rolling financial forecasts.

Conduct monthly budget-versus-actual reviews and drive corrective actions based on variances.

**2. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

Build financial models for new markets, partnerships, and pricing strategies.

Analyse unit economics across individual patient cases, countries, and partner hospitals.

**3. Business Partnering**

Partner with sales, operations, and marketing teams on financial planning and decision-making.

Evaluate business cases, track Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and channel ROI, and support negotiations with hospitals and vendors.

**4. Cash Flow & Treasury Management**

Manage cash flow, working capital, and financial liquidity.

Monitor foreign exchange (FX) exposure and oversee the reconciliation of patient payments, refunds, and partner payouts.

**5. Reporting, Controls & Compliance**

Ensure accurate monthly financial closes and management information system (MIS) reporting.

Strengthen financial controls, approval workflows, and internal processes.

Support GST, TDS, FEMA/RBI compliance, audits, and investor reporting.

**6. Team Management & Systems**

Mentor and guide finance executives.

Improve financial reporting tools, automation, and processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

Requirements & Qualifications

**# Experience:**

2–6 years of experience in FP&A, business finance, or financial controllership.

**# Education:**

CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), or an equivalent qualification.

**# Financial Expertise:**

Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, and translating financial analysis into actionable business decisions.

**# International Finance:**

Hands-on experience with multi-currency transactions, cross-border payment flows, foreign exchange, and relevant regulatory requirements.

**# Tools & Technology:**

Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills, experience with Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, SAP, or similar accounting systems, and familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

**# Accounting & Compliance:**

Working knowledge of Indian accounting standards, GST, TDS, and FEMA/RBI requirements.

**# Communication & Ownership:**

Strong communication and analytical skills, with the ability to explain financial insights to non-finance stakeholders. High ownership, integrity, and discretion in handling sensitive financial data are essential.

**# Preferred Experience:**

Experience in a startup, healthcare, travel, or marketplace business. Exposure to fundraising and investor reporting will be an added advantage.

**# Why Join CureMeAbroad?
﻿**

**Global Impact:**
Be part of a global medical tourism technology and discovery platform connecting patients from high-cost markets such as the US, UK, Germany, and Australia with verified hospitals and surgeons across India, Turkey, Thailand, Mexico, and Spain.

**Fast-Paced Growth:**
Join a fast-scaling global medical tourism brand.

**High Ownership:**
Take ownership of financial planning and performance, with a direct influence on business decisions and growth.

**Leadership Exposure:**
Work directly with the founding team on live deals, international markets, and real business growth targets.

* Perform bank reconciliations and manage accounts payable and receivable, including vendor payments, invoicing and collections follow-up.
* Monitor company expenses and review reimbursements against policy.
* Maintain financial databases, trackers, spreadsheets and reporting tools.

**2. Taxation and Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare and file GST returns, and handle TDS computation, deduction, deposit and return filing.
* Support income tax filings, advance tax and other statutory requirements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations and company policy.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and make sure no due dates are missed.

**3. Audit and Controls**

* Coordinate with statutory, internal and tax auditors, and respond to audit queries on time.
* Implement and maintain internal financial controls, approval workflows and documentation standards.
* Identify gaps in processes and propose practical fixes.

**4. Analysis, Budgeting and Forecasting**

* Conduct financial analysis and prepare budget vs actual variance reports.
* Assist with budgeting, cash flow monitoring and financial forecasting.
* Provide management with clear, accurate financial insights and summaries.

**5. Contracts and Commercial Support**

* Support preparation of basic contracts and agreements using approved templates.
* Read and summaries client and vendor contracts, highlighting payment terms, billing milestones, taxes and other financial obligations for management and legal review.
* Track contract renewals and billing schedules.

Note: This role supports contract preparation and review but does not replace legal counsel. Final legal vetting stays with management or external advisors.
 

**6. AI and Process Improvement**

* Use AI tools and automation to reduce manual work in reconciliations, reporting, data entry and document review.
* Suggest and help implement process improvements across finance, HR and admin
  workflows.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

**Must have**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or a related field.
* 3–5 years of professional accounting experience, including financial reporting, account reconciliation, taxation and audit support.
* Strong grasp of accounting principles and financial processes.
* Working knowledge of Indian taxation, including GST and TDS.
* Advanced MS Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, lookups, financial reporting).
* Proficiency in Tally, QuickBooks, Zoho Books or similar accounting software.
* Comfort with AI tools (for example ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or similar) for everyday work.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with excellent attention to detail.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.

**Good to have**

* CA Inter, CMA, MBA (Finance) or other relevant certifications.
* Exposure to payroll and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT).
* Experience reading or drafting commercial contracts.
* Prior experience in a technology, SaaS or startup environment.
* Experience with ERP or cloud finance tools and basic automation.
* Understanding about HR process and support whenever needed.

**Behavioral skills**

* Strong ownership and ability to work independently, with minimal supervision.
* Good time management and reliability in meeting deadlines.
* Flexibility to switch between finance, HR and admin tasks without losing accuracy.
* Collaborative and approachable when working with teams across functions.
* Discretion in handling confidential financial and employee information.

**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**

* Monthly books closed within an agreed timeline, with clean reconciliations.
* Zero missed statutory deadlines for GST, TDS and payroll compliances.
* Smooth, low-query audits.
* At least a few routine finance or HR/Admin processes simplified using AI or automation.
* HR and Admin teams see Finance as a reliable and responsive partner.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work at the centre of a fast-growing AI company.
* Exposure across finance, HR, admin and commercial functions, with room to grow into a broader business operations or finance leadership role.
* Compensation: Market Standards.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

We are seeking an Opex & Capex Financial Analyst to support the Vodafone Business International (VBI) function in managing opex and capex budgets. description:

To be successful as we deploy finance responsibly to support people and businesses, acting with empathy and integrity, championing innovation and sustainability, for the common good and the long term.

* Strong understanding of Capital Markets products, particularly Credit Markets, Bonds, Fixed Income Securities, FX products, and Fixed Income Derivatives.
* Understanding of trade lifecycle, valuation methodologies, and market conventions across credit products.
* Good understanding of financial accounting principles, ledger impacts, accruals, reserves, and financial statement reporting.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly to traders, risk teams, finance, and senior management.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong alignment with Barclays Values and Mindset, demonstrating integrity, accountability, collaboration, and the confidence to challenge constructively while driving excellence.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Knowledge of Product Control functions, including daily P&L production, attribution, reconciliation, valuation controls, and balance sheet substantiation.
* Knowledge of regulatory capital, market risk, counterparty credit risk, and valuation adjustments (XVA).
* Ability to analyze and explain P&L movements, risk exposures, and valuation changes to trading desks and senior stakeholders.
* Experience in Front Office support, Product Control, Valuations, Market Risk, or Financial Control functions within an investment bank.
* Familiarity with financial reporting, Global Accounting Standards, regulatory reporting, and audit requirements.
* Knowledge of LLMs, VBA, Python, or data visualization tools is advantageous.
* Ability to challenge and investigate valuation, booking, or P&L discrepancies independently.
* Project management and process improvement experience, including automation and control enhancement initiatives.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and changing priorities.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Ensure the maintenance of a strong internal control environment. Review key controls, adjustment substantiation and New, Amends & Cancels trades review, as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
This role will be based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.

* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Sr Controllership Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Banking & Treasury professional will be responsible for managing the company’s banking relationships, daily liquidity, cash flow forecasting, Banking & treasury operations, trade finance and financial risk controls. The role supports efficient fund management, timely payment processes, foreign exchange exposure management, debt and working capital coordination, and compliance with internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements. This position requires close collaboration with business finance, controllership, Shared service centre, tax, legal, and external banking partners to ensure smooth treasury execution in a multinational and listed-company environment.
  
  
Responsibilities for Internal Candidates
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage daily treasury operations including cash positioning, bank balances, fund management, payment planning, Fixed deposits placement (incl renewals) and liquidity monitoring.
* Prepare short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts and support working capital optimization initiatives.
* Maintain and strengthen relationships with domestic and international banks, financial institutions, and other treasury service providers.
* Coordinate banking documentation, account opening/closure, KYC updates, mandates, authorized signatories, certain filings like UFCE, Annexure I, OPI etc.
* Dividend account creation and its distribution for private and listed companies and banking system administration
* Monitor utilization of credit facilities, non-fund based limits, bank guarantees, letters of credit, and short-term borrowing lines.
* Support foreign exchange operations, hedging execution, and exposure tracking in line with approved treasury policies.
* Ensure timely execution of treasury transactions and accurate accounting interface with finance and controllership teams.
* Ensure monthly bank reconciliation statements for all banking relations e.g. current account, deposits, hedges, bank guarantees, LC etc.
* Drive FEMA compliances on w.r.t. EDPMS, IDPMS and MTT records, timely filing of closure
* Prepare treasury MIS, dashboards, and management reports covering cash, deposits, borrowings, investments, bank charges, and FX exposures.
* Drive process improvement, automation, and standardization across banking and treasury activities, including ERP/TMS utilization.
* Support internal and external audits by providing treasury schedules, reconciliations, confirmations, and policy documentation.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, corporate governance requirements, and applicable regulatory frameworks such as FEMA, RBI, Companies Act, SEBI listing obligations, and other relevant statutory guidelines.
* Partner with tax, legal, secretarial, and business finance teams for cross-border transactions, dividend/remittance matters, and treasury-related compliance.
* Review bank fees, optimize banking structures, and identify opportunities for cost savings and improved treasury efficiency.
* Partner /support in-country business teams for driving issuances and closures of bank guarantees/ letter of credits timely.
* Drive reduction of open-ended bank guarantees through addressing customer needs and leveraging global banking relations
* Support/lead working capital financing initiatives as necessary (e.g. Channel Financing, Supplier Financing etc)

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics, or a related discipline.
* MBA (Finance), CA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 5–7 years of relevant experience in banking, corporate treasury, cash management, or finance operations, preferably in a multinational and/or listed company environment.
* Strong understanding of cash flow management, banking products, trade finance instruments, FX operations, and treasury controls.
* Exposure to working capital financing, and banking negotiations will be an advantage.
* Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Knowledge of treasury management systems and digital banking platforms preferred.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Banking relationship management
* Cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning
* Foreign exchange and hedging exposure management
* Working capital and debt monitoring
* Trade finance instruments and documentation
* Treasury reporting and MIS
* Internal controls and compliance orientation
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Process improvement and automation mindset
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional, multinational environment

**Success Measures**

* Accurate and timely cash visibility and forecasting.
* Efficient management of banking operations and treasury transactions.
* Strong compliance record with minimal control exceptions.
* Effective management of liquidity, FX exposure, and borrowing utilization.
* Improved treasury processes, reporting quality, and banking cost optimization.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Financial Reporting - Workiva Specialist
description:
**Job Title:**
Financial Reporting - Workiva Implementation Specialist

**Location:**
Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad

**About Apex Group**

The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and has grown to become one of the world's largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers. With over 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide, Apex delivers cross-jurisdictional services to a diverse global client base. Our success is driven by our people, innovation, and commitment to excellence.

At Apex Group, we empower our employees to take ownership of their careers, develop their skills, and make a meaningful impact. We foster a culture of growth, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Financial Reporting - Workiva Implementation Specialist to join our growing team. The successful candidate will play a key role in preparing, reviewing, and implementing financial reports within the Workiva platform. This position requires strong financial reporting knowledge, hands-on Workiva experience, and exceptional document implementation and formatting skills.

The role involves building reports from scratch, replicating financial statements, managing report implementation activities, and ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality client reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Implement financial reports in Workiva using client-provided Excel and Word source files.
* Build and maintain reports from scratch within Workiva without relying on pre-built templates.
* Prepare and review Annual Financial Statements (AFS) and other financial reports.
* Replicate prior-year financial statements and report formatting with a high degree of accuracy.
* Manage document formatting, tables, notes, page layouts, headers, footers, cross-references, and data linking.
* Import and implement Excel and Word documents into Workiva.
* Troubleshoot formatting and implementation issues within Workiva.
* Perform quality checks and detailed reviews before client delivery.
* Coordinate with onshore teams, clients, auditors, and internal stakeholders to resolve queries and ensure project completion.
* Define reporting timelines and manage multiple deadlines in a production-driven environment.
* Train, mentor, and support team members on Workiva implementation and financial reporting activities.
* Ensure adherence to client requirements, quality standards, and reporting deadlines.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* 2-10 years of experience in Financial Reporting.
* Hands-on experience with Workiva (Wdesk).
* Experience preparing and reviewing Financial Statements and Annual Financial Statements (AFS).
* Strong experience importing and implementing Excel and Word documents in Workiva.
* Advanced knowledge of MS Excel and MS Word.
* Strong document formatting and report-building skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in Fund Administration or Financial Services industry.
* Experience working with Annual Reports, Statutory Financial Statements, and Regulatory Reporting.
* Prior experience training, mentoring, or managing team members.
* Knowledge of financial reporting best practices and quality review processes.

Responsible for supporting the organization’s financial accounting, reporting, Process Improvement & Automation, statutory compliance, internal controls, and month-end/year-end closing processes. Further this role would require indirect oversight of the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of outputs received from other ABC teams, including Payroll, Rebates, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Treasury and other relevant finance operations.
  
  
Avantor is looking for a dynamic, forward-thinking, and experienced Assistant Manager.
  
  
This role will be a full-time position based out of our Pune office.
  
  
Responsible for supporting the organization’s financial accounting, reporting, Process Improvement & Automation, statutory compliance, internal controls, and month-end/year-end closing processes. The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, analytical capabilities, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and business teams.
  
  
The role will also be responsible for creating, Managing, monitoring and reviewing Alteryx based Finance Processes. Further this role would require indirect oversight of the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of outputs received from other ABC teams, including Payroll, Rebates, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Treasury and other relevant finance operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Financial Accounting & Reporting**

* Manage and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of general ledger accounting, journal entries, provisions, accruals, and account reconciliations.
* Prepare and review financial statements and management reporting packs.
* Perform balance sheet reviews and ensure timely resolution of aged or unreconciled items.
* Analyze financial results, identify significant movements and variances, and provide appropriate explanations.
* Ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, including US GAAP / IFRS, as relevant to the organization.
* Support consolidation and group reporting requirements, where applicable.
* Review financial information and accounting outputs received from other ABC teams to ensure consistency with controllership and reporting requirements.

**Financial Controllership & Internal Controls**

* Maintain a strong financial control environment and ensure compliance with established finance policies and procedures.
* Review key financial processes and controls to identify control gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and supporting evidence for accounting transactions.
* Support internal control testing, risk assessments, and remediation of identified control deficiencies.
* Provide indirect oversight of key finance outputs from ABC teams, including Payroll, Rebates, and other relevant processes, ensuring that risks, exceptions, and variances are appropriately identified and addressed.
* Drive standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across controllership processes.

**Audit & Statutory Compliance**

* Coordinate with statutory, internal, and other auditors and ensure timely completion of audit requirements.
* Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documentation, and responses to audit queries.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of agreed corrective actions.
* Support statutory and regulatory compliance requirements applicable to the organization.
* Coordinate with tax and compliance teams on matters relating to GST, TDS, corporate tax, and other statutory requirements, as applicable.

**Month-End & Year-End Closing**

* Drive timely completion of month-end and year-end closing activities in accordance with the finance calendar.
* Review accruals, provisions, prepayments and other key accounting areas.
* Ensure accurate cut-off and appropriate accounting treatment of transactions.
* Monitor open items and ensure timely resolution before reporting deadlines.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement, Commercial, Operations, and other functions to resolve finance and accounting matters.
* Provide accounting guidance to business stakeholders on complex or non-routine transactions.
* Work closely with shared service/finance operations teams to ensure adherence to accounting and reporting requirements.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to management based on accounting and financial analysis.
* Establish effective review mechanisms with ABC teams to monitor the quality and timeliness of process outputs.

**Process Improvement, Automation & Alteryx Solutions**

* Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness of finance processes.
* Create, Manage, Review & Monitor Alteryx workflows supporting finance and controllership processes.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of Alteryx outputs used for accounting, reporting, reconciliations, and reserve calculations.
* Support finance transformation, ERP, reporting, and automation initiatives.
* Develop and monitor appropriate financial controls, SOPs, checklists, and process documentation.
* Promote standardization and best practices across finance processes.

**Team Management**

* Review work performed by team members and provide guidance on accounting and controllership matters.
* Support the development and mentoring of junior finance team members.
* Ensure effective prioritization of activities to meet reporting and compliance deadlines.
* Coordinate with process owners across ABC teams and provide guidance to support consistent and accurate deliverables.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.
* Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience, preferably in Finance Controllership, Financial Reporting, Accounting, or Audit.
* Experience in a multinational organization, large corporate, Big 4, or similar professional environment would be preferred.
* Strong knowledge of US GAAP / IFRS and financial reporting principles.
* Good understanding of statutory audit, internal controls, and financial compliance requirements.
* Hands-on experience with Alteryx, including creation of workflow, workflow review, output validation, issue resolution, and process documentation.
* Experience with ERP systems such as SAP and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working in a global or shared-services environment would be an advantage.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong technical accounting and financial reporting knowledge.
* Experience in process automation and Alteryx-based finance solutions.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and financial controls.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under tight reporting deadlines.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to independently identify issues and drive them to closure.
* Process-improvement and automation mindset.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work collaboratively across functions.
* Ability to exercise effective indirect oversight over cross-functional finance outputs.
* Ability to review and guide the work of junior team members.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
A qualified Chartered Accountant with at least 5 years of post-qualification experience who combines strong technical accounting expertise with a practical business mindset. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in financial closing, reporting, balance-sheet governance, audits, compliance, internal controls & process automation using Alteryx.
  
  
The candidate should also be capable of reviewing and validating outputs from other ABC teams, including Payroll, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, Treasury and Rebates, identifying risks and variances, and ensuring timely resolution through effective stakeholder management. The ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, while guiding junior team members and supporting continuous improvement, will be essential.

Relevant Exp: 10+ Years
  
  
Location: Pune, Noida, Bangalore, Chennai
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary:**
We are seeking a seasoned SAP S/4HANA RTR Lead Consultant with SAP S/4HANA RTR functional & technical experience executing and delivering a complex migration project from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA. The candidate will be responsible for the configuration of SAP S/4HANA Target System to receive selected data migrated from a current SAP ECC system to ensure a seamless transition, while providing expert guidance and support to clients throughout the configuration build, testing and cutover activities of their journey to SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities: Functional and Technical Consulting:**
Leading Workshops AS IS / TO BE Process to map requirements from business process understanding, cost management and reporting, integration with other modules and systems, overall business strategy.
  
  
Provide expert guidance and support in RTR workstream including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cash Management, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis including Margin Analysis. Work with SAP S/4HANA Core Team to configure and customize SAP S/4HANA functionalities to meet client requirements, ensuring adherence to best practices and industry standards.
  
  
Develop technical solutions and enhancements to support data migration, integration, and reporting requirements.
  
  
Provide guidance and support with S/4 HANA transformation project including configuration, Data Migration, providing functional Expertise, trouble shooting, User training.
  
  
Designs and optimizes controlling processes to meet the business needs.
  
  
**Business Process Analysis And Optimization**
Work closely with finance and control departments to understand their processes and needs.
  
  
Analyze existing financial processes and suggest improvements.
  
  
Ensure the SAP system is aligned with business financial operations and reporting requirements.
  
  
**Testing, Training, And Support**
Develop and execute test plans, scenarios, and scripts to validate SAP S/4HANA configurations and functionalities.
  
  
Conduct system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and regression testing to ensure system reliability, accuracy, and performance.
  
  
Collaborate with business users to resolve issues, address concerns, and implement solutions to meet project objectives.
  
  
Train end-users on the functionality of SAP S/4HANA RTR Workstream
  
  
Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for SAP RTR Workstream issues.
  
  
**Integration And Data Migration**
Ensure seamless integration of the S/4 Finance Accounting with other SAP modules like Order to Cash, Sourcing & Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain.
  
  
Oversee data migration from SAP ECC/legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA, ensuring data integrity and accuracy.
  
  
Work with the Selective Data/Bluefield Migration Team on the migration of data from Customer’s SAP ECC System target SAP S/4HANA System to ensure minimal business disruption and maximum efficiency.
  
  
Collaborate with data migration and technical teams on activities regarding data extraction, transformation, and loading into SAP S/4HANA during build, test and cutover phases of the project.
  
  
**Reporting And Analytics**
Develop and maintain financial accounting reports and dashboards using SAP tools.
  
  
Assist in the utilization of SAP S/4HANA's embedded analytics capabilities to provide actionable insights into financial data.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement And Communication**
Act as the primary point of contact for key business and IT stakeholders including business users, project sponsors, and IT teams, providing regular updates, progress reports, and presentations on project status and milestones.
  
  
Proactively engage with stakeholders to gather and validate requirements, address concerns, and obtain feedback throughout the migration and transformation process to SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, fostering trust and confidence in the migration process and deliverables.
  
  
Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  
  
**Skill & Experience Required**
10+ years of experience in RTR workstream including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cash Management, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis including Margin Analysis, implementation and support.
  
  
Strong analytical Skills to analyze complex business data, identify potential issues, business challenges, recommend and develop solutions implementing with SAP Best practices.
  
  
Should be well versed with end-to-end Product costing processes including Material Ledger functionality with integration points with other modules like Product Planning, Materials Management, Order to Cash etc.
  
  
Should have worked on reports and able to identify the requirement and integrate effectively with SAP BW/BI or other reporting tools.
  
  
Certification in SAP S/4HANA is required.
  
  
Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead customer engagements at an executive level.
  
  
Excellent interpersonal skills in areas such as teamwork, facilitation, and negotiation
  
  
Strong written, verbal communication and presentation skills to technical and non-technical audiences including the ability to present and discuss strategies and technical information in a manner that establishes rapport, persuades others, and establishes domain expertise.
  
  
Working knowledge of SAP Activate Roadmap for Central Finance
  
  
Primarily Remote with occasional onsite meetings
  
  
**Nice to Have**
Experience, knowledge in other SAP modules and migration tools, such as Data Migration Cockpit, Materials Management, Sales & Distribution, Production Planning, Inventory Management and Warehouse Management is a plus.

title: Business Outcome Lead - Sub Value Stream
description:
**Job title:**
**Business Outcome Lead - Sub Value Stream**

* The Business Outcome Lead (GCB4) is accountable for defining, driving, and evidencing measurable outcomes across the IWPB Contact Centre within the Voice Channels and Conversational Banking Valuestream. Operating across AMH, EMEA and US markets, the role owns a balanced scorecard that delivers sustainable improvements in cost/capacity, customer experience (CX) and risk/control uplift.
* This role leads cross-functional stakeholders across Operations, Digital, Technology, Data, Finance, Risk/Compliance and Change—focusing teams on outcomes and benefits realisation rather than outputs.

**Opening a world of opportunity**

* HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations. In this role, you’ll help shape and deliver change that improves how customers are served and supported, strengthening resilience and experience across our Contact Centres—work that impacts customers’ everyday lives.
* HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, and we’re proud to support an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

**In This Role, You Will**
**Key accountabilities**
**Own the multi-market outcomes framework and balanced scorecard**

* Define the outcomes framework across Cost/Capacity, CX, Risk/Control with standardised KPI definitions, baselines, targets, and tolerance thresholds.
* Ensure comparability across markets while allowing calibrated local targets based on regulatory, operating model and customer behaviour differences.
* Establish clear ownership for each KPI and benefit line (global vs market).

**Build and govern the outcome roadmap for Voice & Conversational Banking**

* Create and maintain a prioritised 12–18 month outcomes roadmap across all in-scope SVS channels.
* Run quarterly planning and prioritisation, explicitly managing trade-offs between automation, service levels, customer outcomes and control obligations.
* Identify “build once, leverage many” opportunities and drive replication across AMH/EMEA/US.

**Benefits Definition, Tracking And Sustained Realisation**

* Develop robust business cases for initiatives (capacity release, cost-to-serve reduction, demand reduction, conversion/retention where applicable, and risk reduction).
* Implement benefits governance: baselines, benefit methodology, assumptions register, dependency mapping, and post-go-live sustainability checks.
* Partner with Finance to ensure benefits are measurable, credible, and audit-ready (including clear distinction between capacity release and cash savings).

**Channel performance optimisation across SVS scope**

* Accountable for outcome oversight and optimisation across:
* Voice SVS
* AI Enabled Voice & Chat Services SVS
* Chat Platforms SVS
* Chatbot & Voicebot SVS
* Including:
* Define channel-specific KPIs (FCR, AHT/handle time, service level/ASA, chat response times, abandon/timeout, transfer rates, containment/deflection, repeat contacts, rework).
* Drive demand and driver analysis (avoidable contacts, failure demand, bot-to-agent transfers, chat-to-voice escalation).
* Improve end-to-end journeys and handovers (bot → agent, chat → voice) to reduce customer effort and repeat contact.
* Ensure outcomes support customers requiring human assistance, including vulnerable customers, with appropriate guardrails.

**Insight-led performance governance and decision support**

* Establish a multi-time-zone governance cadence (weekly performance pulse, monthly outcomes review, quarterly business reviews).
* Produce executive-ready reporting: narrative, insights, trend drivers, benefits status, risks/issues, and decisions required.
* Promote consistent data definitions and measurement standards across markets and partners.

**Embed risk, conduct and controls into outcome delivery**

* Work with Risk/Compliance to ensure initiatives strengthen controls (QA, complaints, vulnerability handling, record-keeping, data privacy; AI governance where relevant).
* Track risk/control uplift alongside efficiency and CX to prevent single-metric optimisation.
* Ensure evidence is maintained to support audit, regulatory and internal assurance needs.

**Senior stakeholder management and influence (no direct authority)**

* Influence senior stakeholders across the ValueStream and markets to align priorities, secure commitments, and remove blockers.
* Proactively manage dependencies between Operations, Technology, Digital, Data and Change teams; escalate with options, impact assessment and recommendations.

**To Be Successful You Will**
**Knowledge, skills and experience**
**Essential**

* Strong experience in Contact Centre / servicing operations and/or transformation, preferably within financial services.
* Proven outcomes and benefits management capability: KPI design, baselining, benefit sizing, tracking, and sustainability.
* Strong analytical skills: demand/call-driver analysis, root cause investigation, insight-to-action prioritisation.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multi-market, matrixed organisations and lead through influence.
* Excellent executive communication: concise, decision-oriented reporting and governance leadership.

**Desirable**

* Experience with conversational banking, chat platforms, chatbots/voicebots, and AI-enabled servicing.
* Genesys experience/working knowledge (desirable).
* Familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma, Agile delivery, OKRs/outcome-based planning.

**Role level / complexity**

* Significant autonomy with accountability for multi-market outcomes and measurable benefits.
* Shapes priorities and performance management across the Voice Channels and Conversational Banking ValueStream.
* Drives cross-functional alignment and sustained adoption without direct people management authority.

**Key stakeholders**

* Voice Channels & Conversational Banking ValueStream leadership
* IWPB Contact Centre leadership across AMH, EMEA, US
* Workforce Management, Training, Quality Assurance, Complaints
* Digital Channels, Product, CX/VoC, Data & Analytics
* Technology/Engineering (voice/chat/bot platforms), vendors/partners as relevant
* Finance, Risk, Compliance, Change/PMO

title: Risk Systems Engineering
description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who share the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest banks in the world.

**Profile Summary:**

The Risk Management Department at Mizuho International is responsible for delivering an independent assessment of the risks taken across all the trading and origination activities of the Company, and the revenue generated in relation to these risks. It is also responsible for implementing a risk management framework consistent with the Company’s risk appetite and capacity of resources, in agreement with the Company’s Board and Mizuho Securities. The department is led by the Chief Risk Officer and is made up of the following teams:

* Market Risk Management
* Credit Risk Management
* Operational Risk Management
* Regulatory & Liquidity Risk Management
* Model Risk Management
* Risk Analytics
* Risk Reporting

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Implement new reporting requirements
* Work with the Team Lead to implement new risk application functionality
* Work with the Team Lead to migrate legacy Excel and Access tools to C#. SQL, PowerBI and Python based solutions
* Ensure the daily production reporting process runs successfully
* Support the Team Lead to maintain existing application framework
* Assist with testing the application Framework for impact of upstream changes
* Maintain documentation
* Liaise with Strategic IT and Support departments to resolve issues
* Use SQL, Python, and analytics tools to identify and resolve market risk data quality issues across VaR, SVaR, FRTB, stress testing, and regulatory reporting.
* Develop automated controls, dashboards, and AI-enabled solutions to detect data anomalies, reporting exceptions, and reconciliation breaks.
* Partner with Market Risk Managers to communicate risk reporting issues, root causes, and remediation plans, ensuring timely resolution.
* Lead investigations into risk calculation, data, and reporting discrepancies, coordinating across Risk, Front Office, Technology, and Quantitative teams to drive resolution.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Experience:**

**Essential:**

* Knowledge of SQL
* Knowledge of PowerBI
* Knowledge of C#
* Demonstrates capability, potential and willingness to learn
* Genuine interest in technology, engineering and problem solving with the drive and curiosity to continually develop new skills
* Receptive to feedback with a willingness to learn from colleagues, challenge their own assumptions and adapt their approach
* Demonstrates initiative and ownership, actively seeking solutions and opportunities to learn
* Honest and accountable, including being comfortable acknowledging mistakes and raising issues early
* Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to approach unfamiliar problems logically
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly and appropriately

**Desirable:**

* Practical exposure to software development, scripting, data or automation. Can be from professional experience, personal projects, self-learning or formal education.
* Experience with PowerShell, Python
* Experience with PowerBi, SSRS
* Experience of Excel and VBA
* Experience with version control
* Experience within financial services, risk or another controlled environment
* Experience working with data pipelines, automation or large datasets
* Experience with AI tools within a development environment

**Company Overview:**

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.

Mizuho Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

title: Deal Analyst
description:
About the job
 



  





**Get to know us better** 




 We are Gera Developments Private Limited (GDPL), a brand known by our five\-decade history as one of the pioneers in the Real Estate business in Pune. Innovation, transparency, and enhanced customer experience is how we have created award\-winning, premium residential and commercial projects in Pune, Goa, Bengaluru, and California. We live and work by “Let’s Outdo”, a philosophy that defines everything we do to raise the standards of Real Estate in the country.
 



 There are many ‘firsts’ that stand to our credit. Way back in 2004, we introduced India’s first 5\-year Warranty on Real Estate, that RERA mandated only in 2017\. We then introduced India’s first and only 7\-year warranty in Real Estate. In 2014, we designed and launched the award\-winning ChildCentric® Homes, which revolutionised the Real Estate sector for both, the developer, and the home buyer. IntelliplexesTM, SkyVillasTM, and The Imperium series are our other highly successful product lines. In our 50th Year, we launched yet another first\-of\-its\-kind industry initiative—Gera’s Home Equity Power—a means to provide financial flexibility to customers to meet financial emergencies.
 



  





**How the world sees us** 




 It has been an honour to be recognised as an innovative business leader, and an employer to build a career with by some of the best talent in the country.
 



 We’re the only Real Estate company to be recognised in the top 10 mid\-size organisations six times in a row by the Great Places to Work® Institute, and we continue to feature amongst the Top 50 Great Mid\-Size WorkplacesTM 2024 in India. In 2024, we have also been proudly recognised as one of India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Real Estate, and India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Building a Culture of Innovation for All. As we raise the bar on service orientation, product innovation, real estate marketing, and brand building, we are consciously creating a workplace where our employees achieve new heights in their areas of expertise.
 



  





**Our people\-forward culture** 




 How did we achieve this? By cheering for our outdoers. We care about our people, and invest in their success. We cultivate a culture of innovation, inclusiveness, high growth and rewards, inspiring our employees to challenge themselves, and besting their own past performance to achieve their professional goals and their self\-development objectives.
 



  





**ROLE PURPOSE** 




 To support the land acquisition team in screening, analysing, and tracking real estate transactions from lead stage to decision stage, with strong focus on development potential, underwriting accuracy, regulatory diligence, and management\-note preparation.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • Evaluate land, redevelopment, JV/JDA, DM, and plotted development opportunities from first cut to management recommendation.
 



 • Prepare detailed area and yield workings covering plot area, deductions, FSI/TDR/premium FSI, ancillary areas, parking, amenities, carpet, built\-up, and saleable area assumptions.
 



 • Build and update financial models covering land cost, deal structure, approval costs, construction cost, revenue, taxes, cash flows, sensitivities, margin, and IRR.
 



 • Review title, sanction, DP, zoning, road width, access, reservation, TOD / IT\-ITES / local regulation applicability, and other diligence inputs with internal and external teams.
 



 • Prepare Go / No\-Go notes, transaction snapshots, risk registers, assumption trackers, meeting notes, and board / management discussion material.
 



 • Coordinate with Sales, Design, Liaison, Legal, Finance, Records, consultants, brokers, and landowners to close data gaps and move transactions forward.
 



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 • Background in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Planning, Commerce, Finance, Real Estate, or Management; MBA / PGDM / Masters preferred but not mandatory.
 



 • Strong comfort with Excel, financial modelling, area statements, document structuring, and transaction analysis in residential / commercial / redevelopment projects.
 



 • Ability to spot data gaps, challenge weak assumptions, maintain version discipline, and work accurately under fast deal timelines.
 



 • Clear written communication, structured thinking, and confidence in converting scattered inputs into clean, decision\-ready outputs.
 



  





**TOOLS / SUCCESS MEASURES** 




 • Strong Excel and PowerPoint are mandatory; working familiarity with Google Earth / GIS, AutoCAD / drawings, and document trackers is desirable.
 



 • Success will be measured by quality of underwriting.

title: Finance Lead - Evora Service Partner
description:
**Who We Are**
 Evora is an international system integrator with focus on mobile and user experience (UX). We are a trusted partner for innovative digital maintenance and service solutions for global and regional customers in Europe, North America, Asia \& Pacific. As SAP Gold Partner, Service Now Specialist and Click partner (by Salesforce), we offer consulting services, software development, quality assurance services and system integration based on standard components and products, as well as support \& application management. By implementing best\-practice solutions while optimizing their processes, we help our customers to be successful in tomorrow's world.
   

  

 The wisdom, knowledge, and experience of Evora employees at implementing complex workforce management solutions is what sets us apart. We look for the best to hire and to keep. The attractive combination of high\-value consulting services with a competitively priced remote development team has proven to be successful in projects worldwide. With a solid growth, currently 450\+ Evorians are working in offices in India, US, Brazil, Germany, Austria and Spain.
   

  

 As a trusted partner for data\-driven transformation, we help enterprise customers design, build, and operate modern data platforms, business intelligence solutions, and AI\-powered applications across the Microsoft ecosystem. Our team of experienced consultants and engineers delivers end\-to\-end solutions spanning Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Power BI, Azure AI Foundry, and Power Platform. With a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and customer proximity, Evora (Connect) combines deep technical expertise with strategic advisory to empower organisations on their digital journey.
   

  

**About Evora IT Solutions \& Evora Service Partner**
 Evora IT Solutions Group is a global SAP partner delivering innovative IT services and solutions. As part of our growth strategy, we are establishing the Evora Service Partner Centre (“Evora Service Partner”) — an unified, centralised function supporting all Evora entities globally under a single operating model. Phase 1 of Evora Service Partner will serve our Germany and USA entities, with a clear expansion roadmap to additional regions.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Who We Are Looking For**
 The Finance Lead – Evora Service Partner is a senior individual contributor and team lead role based in India, forming part of Evora Group's shared finance delivery model. The role sits within the Evora Service Partner (ESP) organisation in India and operates as a dedicated finance function supporting Evora Group's global entities.
   

  

 You will lead a team of finance professionals in India who provide shared finance services — including general ledger accounting, financial reporting, and process operations — to Evora Group entities globally. While your day\-to\-day employment and people management are with the ESP Head in India, your finance work is directed by and closely aligned with the Global Finance Lead, ensuring full integration with Evora Group's global finance function.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact role for a finance professional who combines technical depth in accounting with a service\-delivery mindset, the ability to build trusted cross\-cultural working relationships, and the drive to lead a team delivering excellence from India to the world.
   

  

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in accounting/finance, with strong exposure to multi\-entity international environments.
* Minimum 3–5 years in a team lead or managerial capacity within a Shared Services Centre (SSC).
* Strong expertise in accounting standards: IFRS and HGB; local GAAP knowledge a plus.
* Deep understanding of month\-end close, balance sheet management, and consolidated financial reporting.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP (S/4HANA or SAP Cloud ERP an advantage).
* Proven track record collaborating with senior global stakeholders and cross\-border teams.
* CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* Fluent English (written and spoken) essential; German language skills a strong advantage.
* Practical experience applying AI tools in a finance or shared services context.
* Proven ability to coach teams on new ways of working; comfortable as an informal AI champion.
* Grounded understanding of responsible AI use: data sensitivity, compliance boundaries, and appropriate human oversight.


**What You Bring**
**Shared Finance Service Delivery**
* Lead the delivery of high\-quality, SLA\-driven finance services from the India team to Evora Group global entities.
* Ensure all deliverables — reporting, reconciliations, close activities — are completed accurately, on time, and to the standard set by the Global Finance Lead.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between the India\-based finance team and the global finance function.
* Monitor service quality, proactively flag issues, and drive resolution in coordination with the Global Finance Lead.


**General Ledger Ownership \& Accounting Excellence**
* End\-to\-end ownership of GL processes for Evora Group international entities supported from India.
* Ensure accurate and timely month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close (HGB, IFRS, applicable local GAAPs).
* Review and approve journal entries, accruals, provisions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Drive strong accounting practices across AP, AR, fixed assets, and intercompany accounting.
* Maintain internal controls, accounting policies, and ongoing audit readiness across all entities served.


**Financial Reporting \& Compliance**
* Prepare and review financial statements in line with HGB, IFRS, and local statutory requirements.
* Support group consolidation and reporting processes in close collaboration with the Global Finance Lead.
* Act as a key liaison for internal and external audits across entities served from India.
* Ensure compliance with tax, regulatory, and governance requirements across jurisdictions.


**Team Leadership within the Shared Service Model**
* Lead, coordinate, and develop the India\-based finance team delivering global finance services.
* Set clear task priorities and workload plans aligned to global finance calendars and deadlines.
* Foster a high\-quality, service\-oriented team culture focused on accuracy, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
* Support team capability development in coordination with the ESP Head and Global Finance Lead.


**Global Finance Collaboration**
* Work closely and proactively with the Global Finance Lead to receive direction, align on priorities, and report on delivery.
* Collaborate with onshore finance teams (Germany HQ and other regional offices) to ensure seamless, aligned service delivery.
* Provide technical accounting guidance and act as a subject matter expert to global finance stakeholders.
* Participate in global finance meetings, planning cycles, and cross\-entity initiatives as required.


**Process Standardisation, Automation \& Transformation**
* Lead standardisation and harmonisation of finance processes across all entities supported from India.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement in closing, reconciliation, and reporting workflows.
* Actively contribute to group\-wide finance transformation initiatives, including SAP Cloud ERP rollout.
* Ensure data integrity, chart of accounts consistency, and strong data governance across entities.


**Systems \& Technology**
* Champion effective ERP usage (SAP preferred) with focus on GL and accounting modules.
* Support implementation, testing, and optimisation of finance tools and platforms.


**AI\-First Leadership \& Team Enablement**
* Champion an AI\-first mindset within the India finance team — not as a technology project, but as a fundamental shift in how the team works, delivers, and grows.
* Model and embed AI\-driven ways of working across close, reporting, and reconciliation processes — from automation of routine tasks to AI\-assisted analysis and commentary.
* Coach team members to use AI as a force multiplier: sharpening human judgment rather than replacing it.
* Identify practical AI leverage points that compress cycle times, reduce manual effort, and raise output quality.
* Set clear guardrails: ensure AI usage stays within Evora's compliance and data classification policies, and that human accountability is maintained where it matters.
* Stay current on AI developments relevant to finance; bring actionable recommendations to the Global Finance Lead.


**What We Offer**
**Our Values** 
 – Collaboration, Commitment, Evolution, Entrepreneurship, Happiness, and Trust form the foundation of our organization and guide the way we work and grow together.
   

  

**Company Culture** 
 – We foster a collaborative environment where teams work together in integrated virtual teams to serve our customers effectively. We are committed to sharing our success with employees through a strong workplace culture and financial participation.
   

  

**Hybrid Work Model** 
 – We follow a hybrid work culture where employees work from the office twice a week, providing flexibility while encouraging collaboration.
   

  

**Great Place to Work** 
 – We are proud to be certified multiple times as a
 *Great Place to Work* 
 , reflecting our commitment to creating a positive and rewarding workplace.
   

  

**Buddy Program** 
 – As part of our hiring process, new joiners are assigned a buddy who helps them understand the team, technology, and company culture before joining, enabling a smoother transition.
   

  

**Growth \& Learning** 
 – We support continuous learning through training sessions and development programs. Employees also receive access to Udemy for upskilling.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 – Our benefits include transportation, office lunch, flexible work options, internet and mobile reimbursements, multiple hub locations, insurance coverage, and more.

title: General Manager/Assistant General Manager - Resort Management at Manori
description:
Role Overview: The General Manager (GM) is responsible for end\-to\-end management of the resort, including administration, day\-to\-day operations, legal and statutory compliance, guest experience, and business growth. The GM will work closely with the owners/management to execute innovative ideas that enhance revenue, profitability, and brand positioning of the resort. Key Responsibilities: 1\. Overall Resort Administration. Lead and manage all departments: Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, Kitchen, Spa/Activities, Security, Engineering, Finance, HR and Stores.
 


* Develop and implement SOPs for all operational areas to ensure consistency, efficiency and high service standards.
* Set annual and monthly operational targets and monitor performance against KPIs (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest satisfaction, costs, etc.).



  





 2\. Day\-to\-Day OperationsOversee daily operations to ensure smooth functioning of the resort across all shifts.
 


* Resolve operational bottlenecks quickly and maintain high standards of cleanliness, safety, and guest service.
* Conduct daily/weekly departmental review meetings and ensure coordination between teams.
* Monitor procurement, inventory and cost control for food, beverages, linens, amenities and other supplies.



  





 3\. Legal, Licensing and Statutory ComplianceEnsure all licenses and registrations (hospitality, FSSAI, liquor, local tourism, pollution control, fire safety, music/entertainment, etc.) are valid, renewed on time and properly documented.
 


* Ensure compliance with local, state and national laws related to labour, wages, ESI, PF, safety and environmental norms.
* Coordinate with legal advisors, chartered accountants and company secretaries to maintain statutory records and filings.
* Handle inspections, audits and visits from government or regulatory authorities, ensuring full cooperation and zero non\-compliance.



  





 4\. Financial Management and ProfitabilityPrepare and manage annual budgets, forecasts and monthly MIS reports in coordination with Finance.
 


* Track revenue streams (rooms, F\&B, banquets, events, activities, spa, ancillary services) and drive strategies to increase yield and profitability.
* Implement cost\-control measures without compromising guest experience and brand standards.
* Review P\&L statements regularly and recommend corrective actions to management.



  





 5\. Revenue Growth, Sales \& Marketing SupportCollaborate with the sales and marketing team/agency on room packages, events, retreats, weddings, conferences and other offerings to boost occupancy and average rates.
 


* Support digital marketing and OTA strategies (website, social media, Google, booking portals) by providing inputs on promotions, guest stories, visual content and campaigns.
* Build and maintain relationships with travel agents, corporates, event planners and local partners to drive business.
* Monitor competitor activity, market trends and guest feedback to refine pricing and positioning.



  





 6\. Innovation, Business Renovation \& Brand BuildingWork with management to identify and execute innovative, creative ideas to upgrade the resort’s product, services and experiences (e.g., themed experiences, wellness retreats, eco\-friendly initiatives, local cultural programs).
 


* Plan and oversee renovation, refurbishment and modernization projects in coordination with architects, vendors and contractors.
* Introduce new revenue streams (activities, curated experiences, memberships, partnerships, merchandise, etc.) aligned with the brand.
* Ensure the resort aligns with a clear brand story and guest value proposition, and that this is reflected in service, décor, communication and guest interactions.



  




* 7\. Guest Experience and Service QualityEnsure a guest\-centric culture in the resort, with consistent, warm and professional service.
* Personally handle VIP guests, important groups and escalated complaints to ensure quick resolution and delight.
* Monitor guest feedback from all channels (in\-person, feedback forms, online reviews) and convert insights into action plans.
* Implement training and coaching for staff on hospitality standards, communication, grooming and guest handling.



  





 8\. People Leadership \& CultureLead by example and build a high\-performance, accountable, and collaborative culture in the resort.
 


* Oversee recruitment, onboarding and training of staff across levels, in coordination with HR.
* Design and implement staff schedules, performance reviews, rewards and disciplinary actions as needed.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, policies on POSH, and a safe, respectful workplace for all employees.



  





 9\. Safety, Security and Risk ManagementEnsure implementation of health, safety and hygiene protocols across the property.
 


* Oversee security arrangements for guests, staff and property assets.
* Develop and periodically review emergency and crisis management plans (fire, medical emergencies, natural disasters, etc.).
* Ensure regular maintenance of all equipment, infrastructure and facilities to minimize breakdowns and risks.



  





 10\. Reporting and Stakeholder ManagementProvide regular updates to promoters/owners on operations, financials, projects and risk areas.
 


* Prepare and present monthly and quarterly performance reports with key insights and recommendations.



 Note: Candidates must have 7\-10 years of experience. Immediate joiners will be preferred. Candidates from Malad, Marve, Vasai, Gorai and Manori locations or nearby areas are encouraged to apply.

title: Accounting and Controls Analyst
description:

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.


**Eligibility Criteria**

description:

**Description \& Requirements**
 Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology \- quickly and accurately. We apply problem\-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes \- all while providing platinum customer support to our clients.
   

  

**Our Team**
 The Company Financials team provides clients with fast and accurate market\-moving data covering broker estimates, financial filings, and other critical datasets that help them assess financial performance. We use financial modeling, industry expertise, data management, and technical skills to curate key metrics and extract insights from our data. Our goal is to deliver a best\-in\-class financial analysis and modeling product while continuously expanding and enhancing our offering.
   

  

 Across Company Financials Data, we are focused on building scalable, observable, and AI\-ready data operations. This includes redesigning workflows, improving process efficiency, embedding automation, and ensuring that financial data is delivered with the quality, consistency, and timeliness our clients expect.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Company Financials Process Automation \& Data Operations team is seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Management Professional to drive operational excellence across financial data workflows. You will leverage data, automation, and process improvement expertise to optimize production, enhance quality and controls, reduce manual effort, and scale AI\-ready workflows. Partnering with Workflow, Product, Engineering, and Data Operations teams, you will deliver solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and client outcomes.
   

  

**We'll Trust You To**
* Analyze workflows and production data to identify bottlenecks, quality risks, and automation opportunities, delivering scalable improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, and consistency
* Partner with Workflow, Product, Engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders to implement workflow, automation, and operational enhancements
* Build monitoring, reporting, quality control, governance, and exception management frameworks that improve visibility, oversight, and operational resilience
* Perform root cause analysis on production issues and develop sustainable solutions that reduce recurring operational risks
* Leverage SQL, Python, ETL/ELT frameworks, GenAI tools, and automation technologies to optimize data acquisition, transformation, validation, and AI\-ready workflows
* Measure and report on operational performance, automation benefits, and process improvement outcomes
* Act as a subject matter expert and mentor, promoting operational excellence and continuous improvement across the organization


**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or a related STEM field (or equivalent experience)
* 4\+ years of experience in data operations, process improvement, workflow automation, and data governance, including data quality management, metadata management, and operational controls
* Strong technical proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformation workflows, and data visualization or workflow monitoring tools (e.g., Qlik Sense, Power BI), with knowledge of data observability, data quality monitoring, and production controls
* Experience identifying inefficiencies and delivering measurable improvements through process optimization, automation, monitoring, reporting, and operational performance frameworks
* Experience developing and maintaining production\-grade automation solutions using modern software engineering practices, including version control, testing, CI/CD, and GenAI\-enabled development tools
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive cross\-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data teams
* Demonstrated continuous career growth within an organization
* Fluency in written and spoken English.


**We'd Love To See**
* Experience working with company financials, financial statements, broker estimates, fundamentals, or capital markets data.
* Familiarity with process improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, value stream mapping, or similar frameworks.
